description_html:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect, Procurement (Pre-Sales, Enterprise) to serve as the technical and functional expert for Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) within our Solutions organization. This role is designed for someone who brings deep procurement domain expertise, technical implementation knowledge, and architect-level solution design skills to accelerate Ramp’s most complex, high-value enterprise evaluations.

You will support enterprise Account Executives and Solutions Consultants in running sophisticated procurement cycles end-to-end — leading deep discovery, validating technical requirements, designing future-state workflows, and creating pre-sale implementation plans that ensure a seamless handoff to onboarding. You will act as Ramp’s primary procurement SME in the sales cycle and will partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales Solutions to influence roadmap and shape how Ramp’s procurement offering evolves.

This is a highly visible, customer-facing role ideal for former P2P implementers, procurement architects, or senior-level SCs with technical depth.

What You'll Do

Lead technical discovery and solution design

  • Conduct deep-dive discovery sessions on procurement workflows, vendor management, sourcing, approvals, catalog strategy, and 3-way match requirements

  • Map customer procurement requirements to Ramp’s capabilities, identifying gaps and designing scalable workarounds

  • Analyze ERP configurations and data structures (Vendor Master, PO, Invoice, Receipt) to ensure compatibility with Ramp’s deployment patterns

Drive technical validation and pre-sale implementation planning

  • Build pre-sale implementation plans (phases, timelines, dependencies) to eliminate re-discovery during onboarding

  • Conduct integration assessments, including API workflow validation, SFTP/data exchange requirements, and security/permissions modeling

  • Create workflow prototypes, configurations, and proof-of-concepts when needed to accelerate technical validation

Partner with Sales to win complex enterprise deals

  • Operate as the procurement technical lead in enterprise opportunities

  • Join high-value and complex P2P evaluations as the primary procurement SME, either as an overlay or as the lead SC for procurement-first deals

  • Quantify customer pain, run gap analyses, and translate procurement challenges into measurable ROI and value propositions

Influence product and GTM strategy

  • Provide structured feedback to Product on gaps, customer needs, and market trends

  • Help shape Ramp’s procurement roadmap and competitive positioning

  • Maintain a bird’s-eye view of the procurement technology landscape to inform strategic decisions

Ensure seamless handoff to onboarding

  • Document all procurement requirements, decisions, and implementation guidance in a standardized format

  • Partner closely with Implementation and Technical Consulting teams to ensure they begin activation without additional discovery

  • Maintain consultative availability throughout onboarding when complex escalations arise

Travel

  • Travel up to 30%+ for onsite discovery workshops, executive briefings, and solution validation sessions

What You Need

  • 8+ years of experience in Procurement, P2P, ERP, or similar technical implementation roles

  • Deep understanding of end-to-end procurement processes, including sourcing, procurement operations, vendor management, AP, bill pay, and contract workflows

  • Hands-on experience designing or implementing P2P solutions (Coupa, Ariba, Zip, Ivalua, Workday, NetSuite, etc.)

  • Strong technical acumen — API experience required, plus familiarity with SFTP, integrations, data migration, SCIM/SAML, and ERP financial objects

  • Experience running enterprise evaluations with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex workflows into clear solutions

  • Ability to design future-state workflows and build pre-sale implementation plans

Nice to Have

  • Certifications in Coupa, Ariba, Workday, or other ERP/P2P platforms

  • SQL or scripting familiarity

  • Experience working closely with Product teams to influence roadmap

title: Senior Account Executive (Enterprise)
description_html:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com

Mattermost is seeking a Senior Account Executive, Enterprise to own and grow a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts across the Americas — with a sharp focus on net-new pipeline generation, executive-level engagement, and complex deal execution. This is a hunter-first role. You will be responsible for identifying and closing new enterprise logos, expanding Mattermost’s footprint within high-value accounts, and navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes across IT, security, procurement, and executive leadership. You’ll work closely with defense-aligned prospects and Fortune 500 customers who rely on Mattermost for mission-critical collaboration.

If you thrive in high-stakes enterprise sales environments, are energized by complex deals with real-world impact, and want to sell software that genuinely matters to the organizations that depend on it — this is your opportunity.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the Americas, driving net-new revenue and strategic expansion within existing customers.
  • Build and execute territory plans including target account mapping, whitespace analysis, and outbound prospecting strategies.
  • Lead the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close for enterprise deals.
  • Engage confidently with VP- and C-level stakeholders across IT, security, procurement, and business units to position Mattermost as a strategic platform.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and value-based presentations tailored to technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to drive deal velocity and ensure successful customer outcomes.
  • Lead contract negotiations, ensuring alignment between customer outcomes and Mattermost’s commercial objectives.
  • Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and account documentation in Salesforce.
  • Represent Mattermost at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements relevant to defense, security, and critical infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven enterprise sales experience in SaaS or enterprise software, with a demonstrated track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals at the senior level.
  • Based on the U.S. East Coast (required)
  • Demonstrated ability to run a full sales cycle from cold outbound to close within large enterprise accounts ($100K+ ACV).
  • Strong consultative selling skills — you ask great questions, listen deeply, and map solutions to business outcomes.
  • Confidence and credibility engaging VP- and C-level stakeholders across technical and business functions.
  • Experience delivering effective product demonstrations and articulating technical value to non-technical buyers.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce; fluency in MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales qualification methodology.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; comfortable working asynchronously in a remote-first environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into enterprise SaaS, cloud, or platform environments with complex technical buying cycles.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity, compliance, DevOps, or secure collaboration platforms — comfort navigating security and IT conversations with enterprise buyers.
  • Experience working alongside technical teams such as Sales Engineers or Solution Architects to advance and close deals.
  • Existing relationships or network within Fortune 500 IT, security, or engineering leadership.
  • Background selling into highly regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or critical infrastructure.
  • Prior experience at a high-growth, remote-first, or open-source software company.

How Success Is Measured

  • Quota attainment: consistent achievement of enterprise ACV and ARR targets.
  • Pipeline generation: self-sourced pipeline as a percentage of total pipeline created.
  • Deal quality: average deal size, sales cycle length, and win rate across enterprise accounts.
  • Executive engagement: multi-threaded relationships and documented executive alignment in target accounts.
  • Cross-functional feedback: positive collaboration scores from Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product partners.

Why Mattermost

  • Mission-driven work: Your deals directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration — from the tactical edge to the enterprise.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership.
  • AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows — you’ll have access to cutting-edge tooling to accelerate your productivity.
  • Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant community shaping the future of secure collaboration.
  • High-growth opportunity: Strong momentum in the defense and enterprise markets, with meaningful equity upside as we scale toward our revenue goals.

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. This role requires the candidate to be based on the U.S. East Coast (Eastern Time Zone).

Target Salary Range: $105,000 to $145,000 USD, plus commission

#LI-KR1

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description_html:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Today, our SMB sales motion is dialed in. The majority of new customers find us; they visit our website, start a trial, or request a walkthrough of the platform. We’ve built a process that converts these visitors into customers at an impressive rate.

Over the past year, our product has become increasingly competitive for support teams at larger companies (100-1,000 employees), but those prospects don’t always arrive on our site ready to engage. That’s where you come in.

This is a true outbound sales role, designed for a rep with world-class prospecting skills. You’ll have the opportunity to not only craft our outbound sales motion, but lead the charge competing (and winning) new upmarket customers at a higher ACV.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

In this role, you will

  • Build and own your pipeline. We expect more than 75% of your opportunities to be self-sourced through target account campaigns, account-based targeting, referrals, events. Inbound will support you; it won't fill your calendar.

  • Run full-cycle deals. You'll land the first meeting, run tailored product demos, build compelling business cases, manage commercial negotiations and seal the deal. You own the sales motion (with support from our amazing team).

  • Build a playbook. What works for you becomes the baseline of our upmarket sales motion. You're the first person running it, and will work with GTM leadership to set our strategy for the future.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. You'll give Product direct feedback on requirements on what mid-market support teams need from us, partner with Marketing to launch targeted campaigns & and work in lockstep with RevOps to ensure our operational process is dialed in.

  • Own numbers. You'll own and report on pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and progress to target with enough rigor that leadership can plan around it.

About you:

  • You've sourced the majority of your own pipeline — 75% or more — and you can be specific about your strategy and results

  • You have 8+ years in full-cycle B2B SaaS sales, working mid-market accounts at companies of roughly 250–1,000 employees.

  • You're at home in a 3-6 month cycle, closing deals with with an average size of $25-$75K

  • You have a real point of view on account selection and engagement strategy

  • You are comfortable managing a modern GTM tech stack and AI solutions for prospect selection, automation, enrichment — you can build a system that works for you

  • You use AI daily to improve your output, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, and scale of what you delivered.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description_html:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com

Mattermost is seeking an experienced and visionary Lead Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to guide the architecture, reliability, and operational excellence of the infrastructure powering our secure, mission-critical collaboration platform.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership across our SRE function, driving strategic initiatives for scalability, observability, performance, and automation across cloud and hybrid environments. You will mentor engineers, establish best practices, and collaborate closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure our customers in defense, government, and critical infrastructure sectors experience exceptional reliability and performance.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Define the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for Mattermost’s site reliability engineering function, aligning infrastructure initiatives with product and business goals.
  • Lead the design, deployment, and optimization of production-grade containerized workloads, infrastructure-as-code, and compliant cloud environments for regulated domains (e.g., FedRAMP, DoD).
  • Establish and evolve observability, monitoring, and alerting frameworks to ensure performance, reliability, and capacity planning at scale.
  • Drive incident management processes, including on-call rotations, root cause analysis, and systemic reliability improvements.
  • Partner with security and compliance teams to meet data sovereignty, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Champion automation and operational excellence to improve efficiency, reduce risk, and scale operations.
  • Oversee cloud cost management and capacity planning to optimize infrastructure spending while meeting performance targets.
  • Build and maintain a developer platform that enables fast, secure software delivery and improves application stability in production.
  • Mentor and coach SRE team members, fostering a culture of learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.

Requirements:

  • BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of relevant experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure roles.
  • Proven expertise in container orchestration platforms, ideally Kubernetes.
  • Extensive experience with infrastructure-as-code, ideally Terraform.
  • Strong background in cloud platforms, ideally AWS.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization strategies.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting and incident management skills for distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language for automation.
  • Excellent communication skills with a track record of influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams in a remote-first environment.

Preferences:

  • Familiarity with observability stacks such as Grafana and Prometheus.
  • Experience designing high-availability, disaster recovery, and scaling architectures.
  • Exposure to GCP and Azure cloud environments.
  • Leadership experience in highly regulated industries such as defense, finance, or critical infrastructure.
  • Experience with U.S. federal compliance frameworks and authorization processes, including FedRAMP, DoD ATO, NIST 800-53, and related government standards.
  • Experience preparing, delivering, and maintaining software offerings through AWS Marketplace and other cloud provider marketplaces (e.g., Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace), including packaging, compliance validation, and ongoing operational support.
  • Open-source contributions in reliability, DevOps, or infrastructure tooling.
  • Certifications in cloud infrastructure, reliability, or DevOps engineering (e.g., CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).

Compensation

Salary range: $145,000 – $200,000

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. Ranges may be updated as market conditions evolve..

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered. For more information visit Security Clearances — United States Department of State

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Director of Product Design

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Your Impact

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger.

A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth.

About the role

  • Lead our product design team as a player/coach. Manage and develop a small team of experienced product designers and stay close to the work through critique, design reviews, and occasional projects of your own. Your most senior individual contributors carry the most complex design problems; your job is to make sure the whole team's work meets the bar. Set clear expectations for craft and ownership and build a culture where critique and feedback make the work better.

  • Turn great design judgment into something that scales. Own the design principles, standards, guardrails, and decision record that make a Help Scout experience feel like Help Scout, so designers, engineers, and AI agents can create high-quality experiences with more speed and autonomy. Your most senior designers author the interaction models and product patterns that sit underneath them.

  • Be accountable for our design system as a product. Set the priorities and resourcing for the Help Scout Design System (HSDS), drive its adoption across Product and Engineering, and make it useful and legible to both people and machines, working with the designer who serves as its technical lead for architecture, patterns, and Figma/code parity.

  • Own how AI shows up in our product. AI is every designer's job, not one person's. You are accountable for Help Scout's point of view on trustworthy AI experiences: how AI communicates, gives people control, handles mistakes, and moves from assisting customers to acting on their behalf. Your most senior designers lead the design direction and patterns; you make sure that point of view is adopted and applied consistently by every designer, and that it evolves with the product.

  • Evolve how design gets done as AI accelerates delivery. Own the operating model: workflows, tooling standards, design debt, how design works with Product and Engineering, and how the capacity AI frees up gets reinvested. Decide which of the practices the team pilots (code prototyping, AI-assisted workflows) become the standard way we work. Your most senior designers shape how AI fits into the design process itself; you make sure that guidance becomes how the team actually works.

  • Help shape product direction alongside Product and Engineering. As a member of our Experience Leadership Team (XLT), bring design judgment, customer understanding, and a clear view of where design investment will have the greatest roadmap impact. Carry business context, constraints, and initiative outcomes back to the design team, and bring designers into the forums where direction for their work is being set.

  • Decide where design capacity goes. Match designers to workstreams based on business priority. Decide who is embedded where, when someone shifts to a higher-priority problem, and when designers move from horizontal work to a deep, time-bound embed in a single workstream.

  • Partner with the Brand Design team in our GTM organization to help ensure design cohesion between marketing and in-app product experiences.

About you

  • You're an experienced product design leader who still loves the work. You bring 10+ years in product design, including 3+ years managing designers, and have been accountable for the experience of a product, as well as the people creating it.

  • You have exceptional product and design judgment. You care about craft in a way that shows up in the details, can clearly articulate why an experience works, and have experience making complex B2B software feel simple and intuitive.

  • You know how to scale great product design. You've built or meaningfully evolved a design system that teams genuinely adopted, and you know how to translate taste and judgment into principles, patterns, and systems others can apply.

  • You have a strong point of view on AI and the future of product design. You use AI throughout your own design practice and think deeply about both how AI changes the way products are designed and how to create AI experiences customers can trust.

  • You know how to lead senior individual contributors. You've managed principal or staff-level designers, given them real scope, and made them more effective without competing with them for the work.

  • You're a deeply cross-functional product leader. You're technically fluent enough to earn the trust of engineers, comfortable using data and customer research to inform your decisions, and skilled at partnering with Product and Engineering on difficult tradeoffs.

  • You're an exceptional communicator and remote leader. You make your thinking visible through clear writing and direct feedback, treat words as part of the product experience, and know how to build trust, alignment, and a strong design culture on a distributed team.

Who you'll work with

  • Chief Product Officer. You report to the CPO and partner closely with them.

  • Chief Revenue Officer. You partner on design cohesion between marketing and product, and on how design shows up in GTM.

  • VP of Engineering. You collaborate on how design and engineering work together, on the design system, and on AI-assisted delivery.

  • Principal Designer. Our most senior individual contributor reports to you and leads product design direction across workstreams, the design direction for AI experiences, and the technical shape of HSDS.

  • Product Designers. A small team of experienced designers embedded in our product workstreams.

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)

description_html:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.

Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.

  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data

title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at METYCLE
description_html:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location

title: Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Moebel De
description_html:
Unser Projekt für Dich:

moebel.de ist eines der führenden Online-Shoppingportale für Möbel und Einrichtung in Europa. Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen.

Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten, vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d).


Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

  • Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
  • Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
  • Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
  • Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
  • Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
  • Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live.
  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.
  • Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte.
  • Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an.


Deine Stärken

  • Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast
  • Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten
  • Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini
  • Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt
  • Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen
  • Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon
  • Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert
  • Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen
  • Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit


Unser Angebot

Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir
Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz.

Unsere Kultur ist einmalig
Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents.

Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week
Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen.

Mitten in Hamburg
Zentral gelegen zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel.


Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bitte richte Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen ausschließlich mithilfe unseres Online-Bewerbungsformulars direkt an unser Recruiting Team.

description_html:

LET’S KEEP THE OFFICE RUNNING.

description_html:

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Kompetenz sowie Erfahrung mit Conversion-Lift-Modellen, Incrementality, Attributionslogiken und Creative-Testing-Methoden
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Social Media-Analysetools (z. B. Meta, LinkedIn) sowie gängigen Kampagnen-, Tracking-, Analyse Tools (z. B. Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Web Analytics, Google Analytics)sowie MS Office
  • Erfahrung im Erstellen von zielgruppenorientierten und kanalübergreifenden Kampagnen
  • Kreative, analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, gepaart mit Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und einem professionellen Auftreten
  • Offenheit für andere Themen rund um Performance Marketing 
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Verständnis, KPI-Orientierung sowie ein test- und hypothesenbasiertes Arbeiten
  • Selbständige Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis für Tracking, Attribution und Datenflüsse sowie sicheren Umgang in Themen wie Events, Cookies und Consent-Management
  • Ausgezeichnete mündliche sowie schriftliche Ausdrucksweise in deutscher Sprache (mindestens C1-Niveau)


Aufgaben

  • Du planst, steuerst und optimierst auf Basis und KPIs unsere Performance-Kampagnen in den Kanälen Paid Social und Retargeting entlang klar definierter Ziele
  • Du optimierst und steuerst von KPI-gestützten Reportings zur Erfolgsmessung und Performance-Optimierung
  • Du erstellst, strukturierst und buchst Kampagnen eigenständig in den relevanten Tools ein und verantworten Budget- und Gebotssteuerung
  • Du koordinierst eigenverantwortlich Aufgaben inkl. Konzeption, Mediaplanung, Analyse, Auswertung und Optimierung von Paid Social und Retargeting Kampagnen
  • Durch kontinuierliche Analysen, A/B-Tests und datengetriebene Optimierungen erhöhst Du nachhaltig Conversion-Rates und die Effizienz unserer Maßnahmen

title: Account Executive - Germany 🇩🇪
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Doctrine
description_html:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


Doctrine employs over 230 people and has been growing steadily and profitably for several years.
In 2025, we are entering a new phase, becoming multi-country and multi-product.
After launching in our first international market, Italy, Doctrine is continuing its global expansion with Germany.
We are therefore looking to several Account Executive in Germany to scale our commercial impact in the German market.
 
A word about the Germany Team ✨
When you join, you’ll be onboarded and supported by your manager, Pascale (Head of New Business), who will help you ramp up and succeed in your role.
You’ll work closely with our first Account Executive on the German market, Danu, collaborating on opportunities and helping drive our growth in Germany.
You’ll also be supported by our broader German go-to-market team 🇩🇪, enabling you to move forward confidently in your conversations with prospects: Audrey (Product Manager), Maïte (Legal Counsel), and Laura (Field Marketing Manager).

Responsibilities
  • Prospect and leverage inbound leads to build a strong pipeline of opportunities
  • Understand the challenges of your prospects, and build relevant go-to-market strategies
  • Run the full sales cycle, from outreach to demos, negotiations, and closing
  • Share insights and learnings from the German market with the internal Germany squad
  • Achieve monthly targets set by the company for your market

    • Profile
  • You are fluent in German
  • You have experience in sales, especially SaaS sales
  • You have a hunter mindset and aim to exceed your sales targets
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills: you listen actively and communicate with empathy, clarity, and precision
  • You are extremely rigorous and detail-oriented
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and a taste for challenges: you thrive in demanding environments, are motivated by performance-based incentives, and appreciate an uncapped variable compensation
  • Knowledge of the legal sector is a plus
  • Travels within France may be required

    • Why join Doctrine
  • We are building the best product on the market with the largest tech team in Europe dedicated to AI applied to law – you’ll be proud to pitch Doctrine!
  • We are ambitious, growing, and have been profitable for several years
  • Doctrine employees are our greatest asset – and that’s not just a slogan: our customer satisfaction from day one has been driven by our team. We invest time, energy, and resources to hire the right people, onboard them effectively, and support their professional development

    • What's in it for you ☀️

    🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

    🌴 A flexible leave policy

    🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

    🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

    📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

    🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

    🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

    👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan

    🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month)

    💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

    🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

    Our values 🤝

    At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

    Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

    Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

    Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

    Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

     Our hiring process 🚀

    1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
    2. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
    3. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
    4. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume.

    (The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

    Ladies, go ahead and apply!

    Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.

    If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!

    Diversity & inclusion

    All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

title: Software Test (QA) Automation Engineer - Mandatory Internship (Unpaid)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at IndieKidz GmbH
description_html:
About Occibo

Occibo is an AI-powered SaaS platform for children's book creation, built by IndieKidz GmbH in Berlin. We're a small, remote-first team looking for a QA intern to help us build and maintain automated testing so we can ship new features quickly and with confidence.

Internship type

Mandatory internship as part of your degree program.
This internship is unpaid.

Tasks

What you'll do

● Build end-to-end UI test automation for the Occibo web app

● Write test plans, test cases, and regression suites for core user flows

● Translate product requirements into automated checks, including edge cases

● Collaborate with the development team on test data strategies and stable selectors

● Run tests in CI, track failures, and help keep the test suite reliable

● Use AI tools to speed up test creation, analysis, and maintenance

Tools you might work with

Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Vitest, GitHub Actions

Requirements

What we're looking for

● Currently enrolled in CS, Software Engineering, or a related field

● Experience with at least one test automation framework (Playwright or Cypress preferred)

● Comfortable with JavaScript or TypeScript and Git

● Understanding of CI pipelines and reliable test design

● Interest in AI and experience using AI tools

● Fluent English

Benefits

● Hands-on experience with a real product, not a classroom exercise

● Direct collaboration with the founder and development team

● A portfolio of shipped QA work you can show future employers

Nice to have

● Prior SaaS UI automation experience

● API testing experience (Postman or REST clients)

● Based in Berlin and able to join onsite occasionally

How to apply

Send a message with your CV, short note/cover letter(preferred), your best project link, the test framework you know, and your availability and start date.

We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2026.

title: Senior Software Entwickler:in
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Schulz.codes GmbH
description_html:
Wir sind schulz codes: sechs Leute, remote-first, zuhause in Darmstadt. Wir gehen in die Entwicklungsteams von Konzernen und Produktfirmen, damit sie danach schneller und verlässlicher liefern.

Nicht als ein Entwickler mehr im Projekt, sondern als die Leute, die den Output vom ganzen Team hochziehen. Das geht nur, wenn wir richtig gut sind; deshalb suchen wir auch nicht schnell, sondern genau.

Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du gehst mit uns in ein Kundenteam, baust dort mit und bist der Mensch, an dem die technischen Fragen hängenbleiben.

Drei Dinge bekommst du hier, und die meinen wir wörtlich.

  • Ownership. Du entscheidest selbst über Architektur mit, sprichst selbst mit den Fachbereichen und stehst dann auch für das, was du entschieden hast. Dauer-Überstunden gehören da ausdrücklich nicht dazu: War eine Woche fordernd, wird die nächste kürzer.
  • Wirksamkeit. Du wirst nicht daran gemessen, wie viele Tickets du zumachst, sondern daran, was das Team um dich herum ein halbes Jahr später kann. Und du siehst das auch, dafür sind wir klein genug.
  • Und wenn dir was nicht passt, sagst du es und änderst es. Bei uns genauso wie beim Kunden. Das ist hier kein Mut, sondern der Job.
  • Das ist eine Senior-Rolle in der Lieferung. Du führst kein Team und wir hängen dir auch keinen Lead-Titel als Karotte vor die Nase. Was du bekommst, ist echte technische Verantwortung, direkter Kundenkontakt und Zeit, richtig gut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ganze Features und Epics verantworten, von der Konzeption bis ins Deployment
  • Dich schnell in fremden Codebasen zurechtfinden und das Gesamtsystem über Backend, Frontend, Infrastruktur und Schnittstellen hinweg sehen
  • Selbst mit den Fachbereichen sprechen, über Architektur entscheiden und dafür geradestehen
  • Integrations- und Skalierungsthemen früh auf den Tisch legen, nicht erst kurz vor dem Release
  • Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Blocker sichtbar machen, kleine Proof-of-Concepts bauen, wenn eine technische Frage anders nicht zu klären ist
  • So schätzen, dass die Unsicherheit mit drinsteht: nicht „fünf Tage", sondern „fünf Tage, Risiko: die API-Spezifikation ist noch unklar"
  • Das Team mitziehen: Pairing, Reviews mit Lerneffekt, Onboarding, Standards und Konventionen, die auch nach dir noch halten

Qualifikation

  • Rund sechs bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre Backend in TypeScript/Node.js in Produktion
  • Architektur selbst verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt: Domain-Driven Design, hexagonale Architektur, modularer Monolith sind Entscheidungen, die du getroffen und dann auch ausgehalten hast
  • Entscheidungen auch dann treffen, wenn die Anforderungen noch wackeln
  • Saubere Modellierung von Fachdomänen
  • Cloud auf Architektur-Ebene, mit bewusster Auswahl der Dienste (AWS, Azure und GCP sind uns gleichwertig)
  • React zuverlässig liefern, ohne Frontend-Spezialist zu sein
  • Tests schreiben, Reviews vorleben
  • Ab Woche eins produktiv in einer fremden Codebase
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, weil du direkt mit deutschen Fachbereichen sprichst

Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Stack

  • Fachlich passende Leute gibt es viele, die Rolle entscheidet sich am Menschen. Drei Dinge müssen bei dir da sein.
  • Lernen als innere Notwendigkeit. Nicht „hab ich gelernt, weil das Projekt es gebraucht hat", sondern der echte Drang zu verstehen und vorne mitzugestalten. AI ist dafür gerade das beste Beispiel: sie soll dich verstärken, damit du weiter kommst und mehr baust, aber dein eigenes Verstehen nie ersetzen.
  • Der Antrieb, das Arbeiten für alle besser zu machen. Nicht nur den eigenen Fortschritt, sondern Team und Kunde spürbar weiterbringen. Menschen um dich herum heben, echte Verbindung aufbauen. Daraus entsteht Vertrauen, und Vertrauen ist bei uns die Grundlage von allem.
  • Ownership, und zwar so wie wir es meinen. Starke Verantwortung für deine Arbeit und ein Stück darüber hinaus, aber ausdrücklich keine Dauer-Überstunden. In der Zeit, die wir uns vornehmen, geben wir unser Bestes, und danach ist Feierabend.
  • Dazu unser härtestes Kriterium: du musst bereit sein, dich auf unsere Arbeitsweise einzulassen. Wir sind sehr offen für deine Ideen und ändern gerne Dinge, aber „so kenne ich das, kommt damit klar" funktioniert hier nicht.

Wann wir nicht zusammenpassen

  • Wenn dich vor allem Gehalt und Titel treiben
  • Wenn du deine Arbeitsweise durchdrücken willst, statt erstmal zu verstehen
  • Wenn dir die Regel wichtiger ist als die Wirkung beim Kunden
  • Wenn du AI benutzt, um dich aus dem Verstehen rauszunehmen

Benefits

  • Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden Projekten und modernen Technologien.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildung durch Konferenzen, Workshops und interne Wissensaustausche.
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitgestaltungs-Spielraum, dein Wort zählt
  • Eine Vielzahl an Benefits
  • kurzer Draht zum Geschäftsführer - regelmäßig 1:1, keine Ebene dazwischen
  • Ein starkes leistungsorientiertes Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und voneinander lernt.

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a  New Business Director (Global ) do at WPP Production? 

The Business Director - Growth & Clients plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production: defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities, deepening our most important client relationships, and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

Reporting into the Global Chief Growth Officer and working closely with the Global Chief Client Officer, this is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win and grow consistently across markets, clients and opportunity types. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will help set the direction of the business and represent growth and clients at a senior level.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities, ensuring that responses are clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across pitches you are leading, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Equally, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, using a deep understanding of their business and objectives to grow relationships and unlock new opportunities.

You will partner with Global Managing Partners on organic and new opportunities and the Global MD of Hex. Hex is the WPP Production Creative Technology and AI Studio specialising in generative AI, agentic AI, gaming, immersive experiences, and robotics. As part of this collaboration, you will come to understand our significant tech and tools partnerships.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth, defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact, high-profile role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth, client satisfaction and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across assigned pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Partner with the Global Chief Client Officer to grow existing relationships, driving organic growth and cross-selling WPP Production's full breadth of capabilities and services
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, providing strategic insights and guidance that help them achieve their business objectives through the right production strategy
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Support financial performance, partnering with Commercial and Finance teams on P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, contribution margins and profit levers across clients and new opportunities
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings and pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Develop and scale team capability through coaching, mentoring and training, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth, client leadership or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Expert client relationship skills in a multi-stakeholder, matrix environment, with a track record of driving up (or turning around) client satisfaction
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative, technology and production
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

title: Channel Account Executive (EMEA)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bitwarden
description_html:
Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 

Bitwarden is seeking a dynamic and motivated Channel AE to join our team. This role will focus primarily on fostering partnerships in EMEA. In your role, you will be responsible for managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans. 

This is an all remote team and we're looking for someone located in the UK who is fluent in either Spanish or Italian and English

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the head of Channel Sales in developing partnerships in EMEA 
  • Provide quotes and pricing to partners in timely manner
  • Manage the deal registration process 
  • Responsible for targeted regions where Bitwarden has taken a channel first strategy
  • Identify and cultivate sales leads within targeted regions, feeding these opportunities to resellers as needed
  • Establish and nurture relationships with key resellers, enabling them to operate autonomously while ensuring alignment with Bitwarden's strategic goals
  • Deliver technical and sales training to emerging partnerships
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to execute joint marketing efforts that drive brand awareness and sales through channel partners
  • Conduct sales calls with partners and potential customers to support the sales process and provide product expertise
  • Establish and nurture relationships with key resellers, enabling them to operate autonomously while ensuring alignment with Bitwarden's strategic goals
  • Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Fluency in English
  • Consistent results in a quota based role
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 2-4 years of experience in partner development,account management, or channel management, 
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with resellers
  • Self-motivated, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a results-oriented mindset
  • Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast
  • Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners' customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Screening call with our Recruiting Manager
  • Interview with Hiring Manager (Head of Channel Sales)
  • Interview with our CSO
  • Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement
  • Final Interview with our CEO
  • Reference Checks

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
  • Become an expert in a growing market. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

title: Partnership Manager (m/w/d) - Healthcare (Krankenkassen)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at 7Mind GmbH
description_html:
Dein Impact

7Mind ist Teil der 7NXT Health Group und eine der führenden Plattformen für Meditation, Achtsamkeit und Prävention im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Die Position ist bei 7Mind angesiedelt, du arbeitest jedoch mit dem gesamten Portfolio der 7NXT Health Group, einschließlich Gymondo. Dein Ziel ist es, unser Healthcare-Geschäft auszubauen, neue Partnerschaften insbesondere im GKV- und PKV-Umfeld zu gewinnen und bestehende Partner nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei bringst du die Perspektive unserer Partner und Entwicklungen im Healthcare-Markt aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Angebote ein.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

  • Neue Partnerschaften gewinnen: Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im GKV- und PKV-Markt und entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften.
  • Netzwerk ausbauen: Du bringst idealerweise ein relevantes Healthcare-Netzwerk mit und baust Beziehungen zu Entscheider und Multiplikator gezielt weiter aus.
  • Partner entwickeln: Du betreust bestehende Partner strategisch und operativ und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.
  • 7NXT-Portfolio nutzen: Du denkst markenübergreifend und entwickelst passende Lösungen aus dem Portfolio von 7Mind, Gymondo und der 7NXT Health Group.
  • Marktchancen nutzen: Du beobachtest Trends und regulatorische Veränderungen, identifizierst neue Chancen und bringst diese in unsere Geschäfts- und Produktentwicklung ein.
  • Produkte weiterentwickeln: Du übersetzt Partnerbedürfnisse und Marktanforderungen in konkrete Impulse für unsere Produkte und arbeitest dafür eng mit Produkt und Marketing zusammen.

Qualifikation

Deine Story

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales, Partnerships oder Key Account Management im Healthcare-Umfeld, idealerweise mit GKV- und/oder PKV-Bezug.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gewinnung und Entwicklung strategischer Partnerschaften und im Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im GKV-/PKV-Umfeld ist ein starkes Plus; alternativ hast du Erfahrung darin, relevante Netzwerke erfolgreich aufzubauen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen, Marktmechanismen und Entscheidungsprozesse im deutschen Gesundheitswesen.
  • Erfahrung darin, Markt- und Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen und in Produkt- und Geschäftschancen zu übersetzen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beziehungsstärke.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung, da du eng mit Partnern im deutschen Gesundheitswesen arbeitest.
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, da Englisch unsere interne Kommunikations- und Arbeitssprache innerhalb der 7NXT Health Group ist.

Benefits

Erfolg braucht gute Energie. Deshalb sorgen wir für die richtigen Rahmenbedingungen — körperlich, mental und im Team:

  • 🏖️ 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr + Heiligabend & Silvester als zusätzliche bezahlte freie Tage
  • 🏠 Hybrides Arbeitsmodell — 60% im Office, 40% von zuhause, gültig für alle Arbeitszeiten
  • 🌍 Bis zu 4 Wochen Work from Abroad pro Jahr (für Berlin-basierte Rollen)
  • 🏋️ Kostenlose Urban Sports Club M Mitgliedschaft & Zugang zu Nilo Health für mentale Gesundheit und persönliche Entwicklung
  • 📱 Kostenloser Zugang zu 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — unsere eigenen digitalen Wellbeing-Produkte
  • 🚲 30 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget via Navit
  • 📚 1.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget + vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Familienfreundliche Benefits — Betreuungskosten & bezahlte Kinderkranktage
  • 🍎 Die Office-Klassiker — Obst- & Gemüsekorb, Müsli & Joghurt (auch vegan), Getränke & Snacks
  • 🐶 Tierfreundliches Office — Vierbeiner sind herzlich willkommen!

Diese Benefits gelten für Vollzeit- und Teilzeit-Festanstellungen. Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen erhalten eine anteilige Auswahl.

Come as you are

Wir feiern Unterschiede und das meinen wir ernst.

Bei 7NXT, Gymondo und 7Mind setzen wir auf Vielfalt, Offenheit und Teamgeist. Ganz gleich, mit welchem Geschlecht du dich identifizierst, ob du eine Behinderung hast, was dein Neurotyp ist, woher du kommst, woran du glaubst oder wie du liebst - du bist bei uns willkommen.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien? Kein Problem. Wenn du Lust hast, mit uns die Zukunft von Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden zu gestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Du brauchst einen barrierearmen Bewerbungsprozess oder hast Fragen zum Ablauf? Schreib uns und wir finden einen Weg.

Über uns

7Mind ist die bekannteste App für Achtsamkeit und mentales Wohlbefinden im deutschsprachigen Raum und Teil der 7NXT Health Group. Gemeinsam mit Gymondo und 7NXT Brand Solutions verfolgen wir eine gemeinsame Mission: We empower people to lead a fit and healthy life.

Was uns bei 7Mind besonders macht: Wir leben, was wir vermitteln. Vertrauen, Offenheit und echte Achtsamkeit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir geben einander den Raum, den es braucht, um kreativ, fokussiert und im eigenen Tempo zu wachsen. Ob Meditation in der Mittagspause, ehrliches Feedback oder neugierige Fragen. Wir glauben daran, dass mentale Gesundheit bei uns selbst beginnt.

Unsere Nutzer:innen stehen im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Wir entwickeln unsere Plattform mit Herz, wissenschaftlichem Anspruch und dem Ziel, mentale Gesundheit zugänglich, alltagstauglich und nachhaltig zu gestalten. Diversität, Inklusion und Nachhaltigkeit sind dabei für uns keine Schlagworte, sondern gelebte Haltung.
