description_html:
Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will work on the core cloud platform that enables all other engineering teams at Qdrant. You’ll design and evolve shared services, control-plane components, and internal APIs that power our managed cloud offering and support enterprise-grade deployments.

This role is about building platform primitives and abstractions, not day-to-day operations. You’ll focus on reducing complexity, improving developer productivity, and driving architectural evolution across the cloud platform.

What you will own

  • Design and evolve core platform services and internal APIs consumed by multiple teams.

  • Drive architectural initiatives such as gRPC migration, eventing/pub-sub foundations, and platform refactors.

  • Own and improve control-plane and cluster-api components.

  • Build platform abstractions that reduce operational and cognitive load for other teams.

  • Write production-grade Go code for platform services and internal tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with Regions & Clusters, Resilience, and Features teams to enable delivery through platform primitives.

  • Improve platform scalability, reliability, and developer experience through thoughtful design.

  • Support production systems and incident response when needed, with a focus on long-term fixes.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python, or deep expertise in one with willingness to work regularly with both.

  • Solid experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and API design.

  • Experience building and operating production systems used by other engineers or teams.

  • Comfortable working cross-team and driving technical alignment.

  • Ownership mindset and clear communication skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with gRPC, event-driven architectures, or control-plane systems.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes operators or cluster-level abstractions.

  • Background in SaaS, database, or systems-level product companies.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.


Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

Come build with us!


For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Comena
description_html:
About Comena

Comena builds AI agents for industrial distributors and manufacturers to automate their order processing from e-mail inbox to ERP. At distributors across the US and Germany alone, there are 4 million sales and procurement people stuck in manual workflows between inbox and ERP. We want to automate this work and liberate these people to work on more meaningful things.

We’re part of the YC S25 batch - the most selective batch in YC history. We recently raised a seed round from top Silicon Valley investors, and are serving customers across US and Germany.

 

About the role

Comena is delivering seven-figure deployments for leading industrial companies across the US, UK and the EU.

As our Forward Deployed Engineering Lead, you will own the bridge between our product, engineering team, and customers, defining how Comena is implemented and scaled across organizations.

You will be responsible for ensuring customers successfully adopt Comena, creating scalable processes for implementation, and helping our engineering team move faster by turning customer learnings into clear technical requirements.

This is a high-ownership role combining customer success, engineering, and operational excellence. You will work closely with customers to understand their workflows, coordinate deployments with engineers, identify recurring implementation challenges, and build the systems that allow us to onboard customers faster as we scale.

Key responsibilities

Customer onboarding and deployment ownership: Lead the full customer implementation lifecycle, from initial discovery through successful production rollout. Own customer onboarding processes, coordinate deployments, and ensure customers successfully adopt Comena’s AI platform. Work closely with customers to understand their workflows, data, and systems, and collaborate with engineers to deliver reliable solutions.

Deployment strategy and process building: Establish the processes, playbooks, and best practices that enable faster and more consistent customer deployments. Identify bottlenecks in onboarding and work with engineering and product teams to improve tooling, documentation, and workflows that make future FDE deployments more efficient.

Cross-functional collaboration: Act as the bridge between customers, founders, and engineers. Translate customer needs and operational challenges into clear technical requirements, coordinate engineering efforts, and ensure alignment between customer expectations and product capabilities.

We’re looking for someone that …

  • Has high agency, can operate independently, and takes ownership of customer outcomes.

  • Has excellent communication skills (fluent English and German is a must) and enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Is comfortable managing complex software deployments and collaborating closely with engineers.

  • Can translate customer workflows and business requirements into actionable technical solutions.

  • Enjoys building processes from scratch and creating scalable systems for a growing company.

  • Has strong problem-solving skills and thrives in ambiguous startup environments.

  • Loves startups and running together to make something great happen.

  • Wants to work very hard beyond traditional 9-5 hours.

Tech Stack

We work with Python (Django), Typescript, Postgres, and the latest LLMs.

 

Why join us?

  • Your work will directly impact workers and companies around the world, to make global supply chains run smoothly.

  • We’re keeping our team deliberately small. We believe more people translate to more output if and only if each member is elite.

  • You’ll be working with cracked founders. Jiehua was the youngest software engineer at Google Zurich and the first sales hire at Lio (YC S23). Almo shipped code at Microsoft and Amazon AWS, and was the first engineer at Leaping AI (YC W25).

  • If you need any perks to feel productive, let us know and we’ll make it happen.

 

About the interview

  1. 15 min intro call with Youssef

  2. 60 min technical interview with Almo

  3. Take-home assignment / case study

  4. In-person co-working day

  5. Offer

Technical Architect (all genders)

Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time · Available immediately

About the Role

You will own the technical architecture of our largest enterprise engagements, from CRM object and data models to integrations and production AI agents. That means you decide how a solution is built, you write the design others build from, and you defend it in front of client architects and IT leadership. If you have been the person who quietly fixed architecture decisions someone else made too late, this is the seat where you make them first.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of our largest enterprise engagements, from object and data model through to integration design.

  • Introduce an architecture review gate so that no significant build starts without a documented, reviewed design.

  • Cut unplanned rework by finding the integration and data-model problems in design instead of in build.

  • Design production-grade agentic solutions on Claude API, MCP, and HubSpot as the data layer, including data access, evaluation, and cost control.

  • Build a reusable library of integration and data-model patterns that shortens every following project.

  • Lead technically in presales: you shape the solution and the estimate behind our enterprise proposals.

  • Raise the technical level around you through architecture reviews, deep-dives, and documentation engineers actually use.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 5 or more years designing architectures for enterprise CRM or comparable business platforms, including at least one multi-brand or multi-business-unit landscape

  • Hands-on integration design between CRM and surrounding systems (ERP, PIM, shop, data platforms) with a clear view on when to use which pattern

  • Experience taking an LLM-based or agentic solution into production, not just prototypes, including data access, evaluation, and cost

  • Architecture documents and decision records you have authored yourself, which engineers built from and clients signed off

  • Ability to hold a technical position with client-side architects and IT leadership, in German and English

  • Solid estimation judgement: you can translate a design into PT and know which choices protect margin

Nice-to-haves

  • HubSpot platform depth (custom objects, data governance, permission models, CMS)

  • Background in custom development or engineering before moving into architecture

  • Consulting or agency experience with multiple parallel clients

Your Team

You will report to the Practice Lead Development & Technology and join the Tech Consulting Team inside Thorit's Development & Technology Practice, alongside the Development, AI, and UX & UI teams. Since the Team Lead Tech Consulting seat is currently unfilled, you work directly with the Practice Lead, with a high degree of autonomy over how architecture is done here. You will work across our Böblingen headquarters and our Lisbon engineering hub.

Tech Stack

HubSpot (CRM, custom objects, CMS), Claude API and MCP, Jira, Confluence, Forecast.it, plus the client-side systems you will integrate against (ERP, PIM, shop platforms, data warehouses) and modern AI-assisted development tooling.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our Böblingen headquarters, with flexible hours and trust instead of tracking

  • 30 days annual leave

  • A company pension scheme (bAV) with employer contribution

  • JobRad leasing and a mobility allowance

  • A certification and training budget you choose how to spend, including AI tooling for daily work

  • Regular exchange with our Lisbon hub, including on-site time there

  • Architecture authority from day one: this is a design role, not a review-committee seat

  • Modern hardware of your choice

About Thorit

Thorit is one of Europe's leading HubSpot partners and a top business and technology consultancy. We combine strategic advisory with hands-on IT implementation, from CRM architecture to fully automated go-to-market infrastructure powered by AI and agentic systems.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but a concrete example of an architecture you designed and took into production, including what you got wrong, is required.

title: US Market & Sales Development Rep - Munich (Native English Required) (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliro
description_html:
Location: Munich
Start: Immediately
Duration: 3-6 months
Type: Full-time internship / Part-Time Working Student

Please note: This role requires native-level American English

Bliro is exploring the US market, and we're looking for someone to lead our very first outbound efforts there - from Munich. Whether you're an exchange student, intern, or just here for a semester abroad - this is a high-ownership, high-visibility role: you'll be talking directly to American prospects every day, and the pipeline you build will shape one of the biggest decisions Bliro makes this year.

About Bliro

At Bliro, we're revolutionizing the daily work of sales teams with AI. 2.5 million field sales reps in Germany alone lose hours every day to manual follow-up work. Bliro solves exactly that problem - with proprietary AI technology developed at TU Munich and funded by the Federal Ministry of Economics and the EU Commission, which transcribes and analyzes customer conversations in real time, whether online or in person. This allows teams worldwide to make data-driven decisions and automate their processes.

Today, more than 2,000 companies already trust Bliro - including fast-growing startups, established corporates, and mid-sized companies (e.g. igus, Lanxess, and Telefónica Deutschland). Backed by top investors, we're now looking for a motivated Sales (SDR) intern to help drive our growth even further.

Our sales team brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world (ex-Deel, ex-Autodesk, ex-Celonis) as well as their own startup founding experience!

👇 See for yourself what you'll be selling to sales teams:

Sounds like the future? It is. And you can help shape it!

🎯 Your Responsibilities

  1. Own outbound prospecting into the US market - research, cold-call, and open conversations with potential customers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.

  2. Qualify leads rigorously, distinguishing genuine buying interest from polite enthusiasm - you'll need good instincts for reading US business conversations specifically.

  3. Book and manage a pipeline of introductory calls and demos.

  4. Work closely with founders and the Account Executive team to shape how we position Bliro for American prospects.

  5. Bring structure to a brand-new motion - there's no existing playbook here, so your feedback on what works will directly influence our approach.

  6. Support a leadership visit to the US to meet prospects in person, helping prepare briefings and scheduling.

🧠 Your Profile

We're not looking for finished professionals - we're looking for doers with passion and curiosity.

What you should bring:

  • Native or near-native American English speaker, with genuine fluency in US business communication norms and small talk.

  • Confident and natural on the phone - you can build rapport with a stranger quickly.

  • Currently a student (any field) or in a gap year, based in or able to work from Munich for the duration of the role.

  • Resilient and self-motivated - comfortable with high call volume and undeterred by rejection.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Prior experience in outbound sales (e.g. internships, working student jobs, part-time jobs)

  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or other outreach tools

  • Working German sufficient to collaborate day-to-day with the Munich team (native German not required).

💡 Why Bliro

💸 Compensation + perks worth mentioning
This isn't an "internship for experience" - you'll get a fair salary, an uncapped variable bonus (yes, even as an intern), a Deutschlandticket, Wellpass, and food and drinks in the office. Your effort gets rewarded. Learning budget? We've got it. Sales library? Of course. Personal coaching? Included too

🌍 20 people, 9 countries, one network
Here you'll meet creativity and internationality. You'll work with people who think along with you, laugh with you, and want to grow with you. Our team also brings experience from the fastest-growing software companies in the world. On top of that, you'll benefit from our strong network in Munich's startup ecosystem - with connections to VCs and founders.

📍 An office location that's hard to beat

Our office sits right above the Augustiner Stammhaus - right in the heart of Munich. Whether it's lunch with a view of the city or a quick after-work beer around the corner: you won't find a better neighborhood.

🥳 Real team spirit, every month

We don't wait for the annual offsite. At Bliro, there are monthly team events - from mini golf and bowling to burrito nights and pickleball. Spontaneous lunches and coffee breaks included.

🧑‍💻 Flexible
9 to 5 not your thing? No problem. Whether from your kitchen table or the office - what matters to us is the result, not the location. And yes, pajama pants are officially allowed when working from home.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You'll never pitch alone
Your start at Bliro will be accompanied by a buddy who onboards you, catches you when needed, and keeps you supplied with memes. We're team players - from day one to your first successful demo (and beyond).

Do you want to experience and help shape the sales side of an AI startup from the ground up? Then apply now!

Let's build the future of Sales - together. 💥

title: Sr Marketing Manager - DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Legora
description_html:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

You are joining an early-stage scale-up with exceptional product-market fit, trusted by leading DACH firms like Boehringer Ingelheim, Roland Berger, and SGS SA. Backed by over $600M in funding from top investors including Accel, ICONIQ, General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, Benchmark, Redpoint, and Y Combinator. And a world-class team from Google, Klarna, Spotify, Slack, and top tier consulting and law firms with infinite room to grow professionally.

The Role

We're looking for a marketing manager to join our Munich team and lead the execution of high-impact marketing programs across DACH. This role will play a key part in driving brand awareness, pipeline growth, and customer loyalty through regional field initiatives, including creative brand marketing, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, field marketing, community, and content marketing.

You'll report to the Marketing Director for EMEA and collaborate closely with the global marketing team, including demand generation, product marketing, content, and design. You'll be embedded in the regional go-to-market and engagement teams to plan and execute programs that drive customer acquisition, engage target accounts, and nurture customer relationships. You will play a key role towards achieving new business pipeline, upsell pipeline and renewals targets across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow Legora's brand presence across DACH, ensuring Legora shows up wherever our customers are with consistent positioning and messaging across all regional marketing activities.

  • Develop regional marketing strategy and campaign plans, defining objectives, target audiences, messaging themes, and channel mix to drive awareness, engagement, and pipeline contribution.

  • Lead the conception and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, coordinating across digital, social, content, and in-person channels to deliver cohesive go-to-market initiatives.

  • Design and manage regional field marketing programs, including industry conferences, community events, sponsorships, and Legora-hosted experiences tailored to DACH buyers.

  • Partner with the DACH sales and partner teams to align marketing initiatives with pipeline goals, account strategies, and customer acquisition priorities.

  • Own end-to-end event production, including venue selection, vendor management, attendee communications, GTM enablement, run-of-show planning, content and speaker preparation, onsite execution, and post-event processing.

  • Build, manage and execute a pipeline of customer stories which translate Legora's impact into compelling proof points, driving advocacy and loyalty.

  • Develop content amplification strategies that extend the reach of Legora's thought leadership, product stories, and customer narratives across relevant DACH channels.

  • Execute targeted demand-generation campaigns that support field programs, leveraging email, paid media, social, and out-of-home placements to drive attendance, engagement, and conversions.

  • Source and activate customer advocates, identifying DACH customers for case studies, co-marketing opportunities, testimonials, and speaking engagements.

  • Track performance of all regional marketing activities, analyzing results, reporting ROI, and using insights to refine and optimize future programs.

  • Manage relationships with regional agencies, vendors, and marketing partners, ensuring seamless collaboration, quality execution, and budget adherence.

  • Generate creative concepts that elevate brand experience, enhancing engagement, differentiation, and the overall impact of Legora's presence at every touchpoint.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B marketing, prefer ably in SaaS or technology sectors, or in a creative marketing role in an agency environment.

  • Hands-on experience supporting events, sponsorships, or regional campaigns.

  • Strong creative instincts paired with a bias for action and ability to execute with speed and precision.

  • Ability to wear multiple hats as needed in a dynamic, rapidly evolving organisation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable collaborating across functions and regions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with marketing automation and GTM/CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Pardot, Customer.io, Clay) is a plus.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hast gute Englischkenntnisse

description_html:
For an international HR IT separation and stand-alone program, we are looking for an experienced Senior HR IT Project Lead to support the project on a full-time basis.

The role combines operational project leadership with strong technical HR IT understanding. The consultant will work across several HR IT workstreams, identify dependencies and blockers, actively drive topics forward, and closely support internal workstream owners where HR IT knowledge is currently limited.

This is not a pure PMO or reporting role. We are looking for someone who can understand complex HR system landscapes, challenge technical topics, structure unclear situations and actively push workstreams toward delivery.

  • Start: October 2026
  • Duration: 6 months
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Location: Predominantly remote (very occasional workshops onsite)
  • Language: English
  • Contract type: Freelance / B2B

Tasks

  • Take operational ownership across several HR IT workstreams within an international carve-out / separation program
  • Coordinate technical and functional activities across SAP HCM and related HR systems
  • Drive interface, integration and data-flow topics between HR applications
  • Identify blockers, risks and dependencies and actively push resolution
  • Closely support and coach internal workstream owners with limited HR IT experience
  • Manage dependencies between Recruiting, Core HR, Payroll, Workforce/Time and other HR systems
  • Track critical work packages and escalate delays where required
  • Work independently with internal stakeholders and external delivery partners

Requirements

  • Senior experience in complex HR IT transformation or separation programs
  • Strong SAP HCM / SAP HR background
  • Very good understanding of HR system integrations, interfaces and data flows
  • Proven project or workstream leadership experience
  • Experience with international HR system landscapes
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to quickly structure complex situations and drive topics independently
  • Excellent English skills

Nice-to-haves:

  • Carve-out, divestiture, TSA exit or stand-alone setup experience
  • SuccessFactors and/or SmartRecruiters experience
  • Payroll and/or Workforce Management / Time & Attendance experience
  • SAP HCM exposure in APAC and/or the Americas

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du kommst aus der Social-Bubble, bist auf den gängigen Kanälen zuhause und entwickelst für Marken nicht nur unique Looks, sondern auch Content-Pieces, die wirklich performen? Volltreffer! Wir wachsen und suchen einen kreativen Kopf, der mit uns die Brand Channels nationaler und internationaler Marken proaktiv voranbringt. 

 

  • Visuelle Führung von Marken auf Social Media – von der Entwicklung der Social Identity bis zur Umsetzung in Stills, Video und Motion
  • Konzeption und Realisierung kreativer, plattformgerechter Ideen für Kampagnen und Always-on
  • Kreative Steuerung und Umsetzung von Produktionen – von schnellen, pragmatischen Social-Formaten bis zu aufwändigeren TVC-Begleitungen
  • Entwicklung von Social Media Guides und Vorlagen-Kits für eine effiziente und skalierbare Content-Produktion
  • Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Design- und Produktionsstandards
  • Mentoring und fachliche Weiterentwicklung von Junior Content Creators


Dein Profil

Ob Stills oder Videos – du kannst deine Visionen hands-on präsentieren und umsetzen. Du findest proaktiv Lösungen, führst Projekte eigenständig ins Ziel und arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen. 
 

  • mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Kreativ- und Social-Media-Umfeld – idealerweise in der Agenturwelt
  • ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Kultur, Social-Media-Trends, visuelle Kommunikation und plattformspezifischen Content
  • sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Design-, Editing- und Content-Tools – auch mit professionellen Grafiktools über Canva hinaus
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Influencer:innen und Steuerung von Creator:innen
  • Erfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung von Content-Produktionen
  • eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und den Anspruch, Dinge eigenständig voranzutreiben
  • Teamplayer-Mentalität mit Lust, in Eigeninitiative Wissen zu teilen und andere zu entwickeln


Wir bieten

  •  Große und kleine Marken, die langfristig geführt werden – nicht nur kurzfristig bespielt

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit eigenem Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Kurze Abstimmungswege und flache Hierarchien
  • Gemeinsamer Aufbau deines Kreativ-Teams
  • Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Workation bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr
  • Gesundheit und Fitness: Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaften (u. a. Urban Sports Club und Beat21) sowie ein wöchentlicher Rückenfitnesskurs direkt im Paulihaus
  • Eines der schönsten Büros der Stadt, mitten im Schanzenviertel

title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Greencells Gmbh
description_html:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

description_html:
Deine Rolle bei Karriere Tutor

Karriere Tutor steht für moderne, praxisnahe Weiterbildung und Umschulung – und für eine Lernkultur, die Menschen stark macht. Du möchtest mit deinem Know-how und deiner Persönlichkeit etwas bewegen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und begleite unsere Teilnehmenden in ihrer persönlichen Entwicklung. 

So sieht dein Tag bei uns aus:

Als Team Lead für Weiterbildungsangebote im Team AI und Data Science AI verantwortest du die Durchführung und inhaltliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kurse im Team KI und Data Science. 

Dafür führst du ein Team von Dozierenden, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kursproduktionen und -inhalte für unser Produktmanagement und sorgst mit deinem Team für eine qualitativ hochwertige und didaktisch wertvolle Vermittlung der Inhalte an unsere Teilnehmenden.    

  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team von Dozierenden im Bereich Data & AI und gibst fachliche Orientierung für die Weiterentwicklung der Kurse.  
  • Du gibst als Subject Matter Expert wichtigen Input zur Weiterentwicklung des Kursportfolios deines Themenfelds ein, hilfst uns inhaltliche Trends zu erkennen und relevante Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen zu entwickeln.  
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning und Analytics und leitest daraus relevante Themen, Technologien und Qualifizierungsangebote für unser Portfolio ab.  
  • Du stellst die fachliche Qualität unserer Weiterbildungen sicher und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Inhalte, Lernziele, Konzepte und Formate kontinuierlich weiter.  
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden und Fachexpert:innen zusammen und unterstützt sie bei der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Kurse.  
  • Du stellst die adäquate qualitative und quantitative Besetzung deines Teams mit internen und externen Dozierenden sicher und steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Dispositions-Team ihren Einsatz in Lehre und Kursproduktionen. 
  • Du analysierst Markt-, Kunden- und Teilnehmendenfeedback und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um bestehende Angebote zu optimieren und neue Angebote zu entwickeln.  
Kurz: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser AI und Data Science Weiterbildungsportfolio fachlich relevant, technologisch aktuell und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich bleibt. 


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Data & AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld.  
  • Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams bzw. Netzwerken.  
  • Fundiertes Verständnis aktueller Entwicklungen im Bereich Data & AI sowie ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Technologien und Kompetenzen für Arbeitsmarkt und Weiterbildung relevant sind.  
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung oder Steuerung von Weiterbildungs-, Trainings- oder Qualifizierungsangeboten.  
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Dozierenden, Fachexpert:innen und unterschiedlichen internen Stakeholdern.  
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.  
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Das wäre ein Plus:
  • Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung oder beruflichen Weiterbildung.  
  • AEVO-Schein (AdA), Train the Trainer oder eine vergleichbare berufspädagogische Qualifikation.  
  • Erfahrung mit Python, Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, BI oder generativer AI.  


Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Work & Travel: Verbinde deinen Job mit Reisen – bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Ob du die Welt bereisen, Abenteuer erleben oder dich einfach erholen möchtest – wir geben dir den Freiraum dafür.
  • Weiterbildung: Lebenslanges Lernen gehört bei uns dazu! Wir fördern dich bei deiner Karriereplanung.
  • Wellhub: Für mehr Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und Bewegung – mit digitalen Tools und Fitnessangeboten vor Ort, ganz flexibel nach deinem Bedarf.
  • Team Spirit: Wir setzen auf ein Miteinander – flache Hierarchien, Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Teamtreffen.
  • Zukunftsorientiert: Wir sichern dich ab – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge bis zum Kindergartenzuschuss. Wir denken heute schon an übermorgen für dich und deine Familie!
  • Corporate Benefits: Auf der Suche nach dem nächsten Deal? Bei uns bekommst du zahlreiche Vergünstigungen und exklusive Angebote.


Hier wirst du gebraucht

Wir freuen uns auf deine Unterstützung an unseren Umschulungsstandorten in Augsburg, Braunschweig, Bremen, Köln, Leipzig und München. Teile uns deinen bevorzugten Arbeitsort einfach im Rahmen deiner Bewerbung mit!

title: Senior Associate (m/w/d) Restrukturierung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Brl
description_html:
Es kommt drauf an - wo und mit wem man arbeitet!

Vollzeit | unbefristet | zu sofort

Wenn Finanzierung, Strategie und Recht zusammenfinden müssen, kommt es auf Menschen an, die den Überblick behalten. 

Wir beraten unsere Mandanten mit klarem Blick für das Machbare: von der frühzeitigen Krisenerkennung und der Restrukturierung von Finanzierungen über StaRUG-Strukturen bis hin zu komplexen M&A- und Carve-out-Prozessen. Dabei verbinden wir rechtliche Präzision mit wirtschaftlichem Verständnis und arbeiten eng mit unseren Experten aus Corporate, M&A, Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung zusammen. 
Für unser wachsendes Restrukturierungsteam suchen wir Sie als Senior Associate (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung. Sie arbeiten unmittelbar mit Mandanten und Finanzierungspartnern, übernehmen früh Verantwortung und gestalten anspruchsvolle Lösungen aktiv mit. 


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie beraten Unternehmen, Gesellschafter und Finanzierungspartner in Krisen- und Restrukturierungssituationen.
  • Sie begleitenvorinsolvenzliche Restrukturierungen, insbesondere StaRUG-Verfahren.
  • Sie gestalten und verhandeln Sanierungsvereinbarungen sowie Kredit- und Finanzierungsverträge.
  • Sie begleiten M&A-Transaktionen mit finanzierungsrechtlichem Schwerpunkt.
  • Sie übernehmen eigene Mandatsverantwortung und gestalten den weiteren Ausbau unseres Restrukturierungsbereichs aktiv mit.


Ihr Profil

  • Volljurist/in mit überdurchschnittlichen Examina
  • Min. vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzberatung
  • Unternehmerisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis
  • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Teamplayer mit sicherem Auftreten und Freude am Mandantenkontakt
  • Ausgeprägte Affinität zu digitalen Arbeitsweisen und neuen Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, deren Einsatz in der Mandatsarbeit weiterzuentwickeln
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

  • Mandate mit Wirkung: Sie arbeiten an Situationen, in denen rechtliche Entscheidungen unmittelbare wirtschaftliche Bedeutung haben – und helfen Mandanten, wieder Handlungsspielraum zu gewinnen. 
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Rechtsanwälte, Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und Restrukturierungsexperten sitzen bei uns unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht kurze Wege und Lösungen, die rechtliche, finanzielle und steuerliche Perspektiven verbinden. 
  • Technologie im Wandel: KI und Digitalisierung verändern auch die Arbeit in der Restrukturierung. Bei BRL erleben Sie diese Entwicklung nicht nur bei unseren Mandanten, sondern gestalten sie in einer multidisziplinären Kanzlei mit. 
  • Verantwortung und Entwicklung: Sie erhalten früh direkten Mandantenkontakt, übernehmen Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche und entwickeln sich in einem strategisch wachsenden Beratungsfeld weiter. 
  • Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, kommunizieren offen und unterstützen einander auch dann, wenn Mandate komplex und zeitkritisch werden.
  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. 
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile: Individuelle Weiterbildung, Mobilitätszuschüsse. 
  • Vergütung:  Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung mit leistungsbezogener Komponente, Entwicklungsperspektive und Beteiligung an geworbenen Mandaten.

title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Climate
description_html:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

  • Bike rental discount

  • Optional company pension plan


Conditions

  • Application deadline: Open until filled

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.

  • Remuneration: The range is EUR 4,363 (Masters plus 5+ relevant years outside of university studies) to EUR 4,810 (9+ years relevant experience outside of Masters'), in accordance with level 4 steps 1 to 3 of our remuneration scales

  • Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.


Please apply with your CV and a cover letter addressing essential criteria, listing of three references, and include your earliest start date and salary expectations. Please use PDF format exclusively using the application form. Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed.


We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

title: Director Strategic Operations (m/f/d)

description_html:
Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience improving leadership productivity through AI-enabled tools and efficient operating rhythms.


Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

We could tell you about the free breakfast, the drinks in the fridge, and the 30 vacation days. Or that flexible hours and remote work are part of the deal. But honestly? That's just standard.
Here's what makes working with us in Frankfurt extra special:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere - Take your job with you on a workation and get inspired by new places.
  • Time for growth - A career framework to support your professional and personal growth with up to 6 extra days off per year for your development.
  • Social Day - One paid day per year to give back: volunteer, support a cause, or attend an environmental event.
  • Bike leasing - Stay fit and sustainable. We'll handle the contract and insurance.
  • Pick your perk - Choose the benefit that fits your life best: fitness membership, public transport pass, retirement plan, or a monthly bonus.
  • Dog Friendly Office - Bring your furry coworker along. Just make sure they don't steal anyone's lunch.
Hybrid work is a natural part of how we operate, but we also believe in the power of coming together. That's why we regularly connect in the office whenever it makes sense. And that's just the beginning. Ask us what else is waiting for you!


Your contact person

Send us your application, including your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, directly through our online portal via the "Apply for this job" button. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Patrick Ziegler.
We ask for your understanding that MATRIX42 can only accept applications online via the applicant portal in connection with our applicant management system due to the currently valid EU data protection regulations.

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Photoroom
description_html:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Chef(fe) de projet déploiement solution SAAS
description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Pour accompagner le développement de nos projets et répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous renforçons notre équipe Consulting. Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet déploiement pour piloter l’implémentation de la solution Vertical Expense chez nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes internes (technique, produit, CSM) et les interlocuteurs client (DSI, DAF, DRH, métiers).

Tu interviendras au cœur des projets, de la compréhension des besoins, au paramétrage de la solution, en passant par l’accompagnement des utilisateurs.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Piloter les projets de déploiement de A à Z, du cadrage à la mise en production.

  • Analyser les besoins des clients et les conseiller sur l’optimisation de leurs processus.

  • Animer les ateliers projet et assurer la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger et faire valider les spécifications fonctionnelles et les livrables projet.

  • Organiser et réaliser le paramétrage de la solution selon les règles métier du client.

  • Accompagner les intégrations techniques (connecteurs ERP/SIRH, SSO, API…)

  • Assurer les phases de tests, recettes, formations, et transfert vers les équipes support.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus de delivery.

  • Être un relais actif du retour client vers les équipes produit.

  • Assurer le suivi des projets et garantir la satisfaction client.


Ce qu’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience réussie en tant que chef(fe) de projet fonctionnel ou consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) dans le cadre d’un projet de déploiement (Solutions Finance, RH, ERP ou SIRH... est un plus).

  • Tu maîtrises les bases de données et SQL, et tu comprends les environnements web, API, SSO et formats d’échange.

  • Tu possèdes un bon niveau fonctionnel, notamment sur les sujets de comptabilité, frais professionnels et processus métier.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les projets multi-interlocuteurs et sais adopter une posture de conseil fonctionnel auprès des clients.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et communiques avec aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la réussite des projets et la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et bienveillante, favorisant le partage de connaissances, tout en développant ton expertise fonctionnelle grâce à des missions variées et un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien téléphonique RH.

  2. Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  3. Seconde mise en situation (en autonomie) : cas pratique de paramétrage sur un environnement de test.

  4. Échange avec la Head of Delivery, le Project Manager et RH (1h).

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, rémunération : 45k à 50k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Doctrine
description_html:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

title: Staff Software Backend Engineer, Tech Lead - Foundations
description_html:
NetBox Labs seeks a Staff Software Backend Engineer to technically lead our Foundations team. Foundations is the platform team that builds shared platform primitives that other engineering teams depend on including core services for authentication, access control, customer secrets management, and customer telemetry. This role will own the technical direction for Foundations. You will partner with the Foundations Engineering Manager, who owns people and process, while you own architecture and technical execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture of the Platform Authorization Service (PAS), the system that controls access across the platform.

  • Set the technical direction for identity, single sign-on (SSO), access control, secrets management services and more.

  • Lead delivery of Foundations core services, including login, authorization, and tenancy.

  • Act as the primary technical decision maker for Foundations.

  • Lead and mentor the Foundations engineering team through daily technical work.

  • Partner with the Foundations Engineering Manager and Product Manager on team execution.

  • Drive core components through to GA (general availability) launch.

  • Define API contracts for platform services that others consume, including Delivery Platform and Application teams.

  • Work with the Foundations Product Manager to align technical plans with product priorities.

  • Set engineering standards for code review, testing, and documentation across the team.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a platform or infrastructure area.

  • 3+ years of experience in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization.

  • Direct experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, OAuth, SSO, or role-based access control).

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority.

  • Backend programming experience in Python and Go.

  • Experience designing APIs consumed by other engineering teams.

  • Strong Linux and distributed systems fundamentals.

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Experience with network management or infrastructure software (for example, NetBox).

  • Open-source contributions or project involvement.

  • Comfort with AI-enhanced tooling (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor).

Join NetBox Labs. Help build the identity and access foundation the rest of the platform relies on.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.
