title: Deployment Strategist, Eastern Europe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at TRM Labs
description_html:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

At TRM Labs, our Deployment Strategy team is on the front lines of customer experience – bridging product expertise with exceptional customer support. The team ensures our customers receive timely, accurate, and high-quality assistance at every step. You will work daily with leading financial institutions and crypto exchanges, — providing value through expert guidance, responsive support, and trusted partnership.

As a Deployment Strategist (Eastern Europe), you will play a critical role in helping TRM customers realise the full value of our platform. You will partner with crypto businesses to trace illicit funds, operationalise scalable compliance programs, and disrupt financial crime across the crypto ecosystem. You will manage a portfolio of strategic accounts, driving adoption of TRM’s tools, and ensuring customers achieve measurable, long-term impact.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Act as a trusted advisor, enabling and crypto businesses to maximise the effectiveness of our platform within their investigative, supervisory, risk, and compliance functions.

  • Confidently explain complex technical and investigative concepts, supporting customer teams in interpreting blockchain data, building cases, and conducting financial crime investigations.

  • Build and deliver product demonstrations tailored to investigators, analysts, compliance officers, supervisors, and risk teams across the private sectors, showing how TRM can be used in real scenarios to uncover networks, follow the money, and disrupt financial crime.

  • Conduct structured training sessions to ensure TRM is embedded into customers’ day-to-day investigative and compliance programs.

  • Serve as the “Voice of the Customer” by channeling customer feedback to product and engineering teams to influence product direction.

  • Monitor customer engagement and usage trends, identifying risks and opportunities to drive measurable outcomes.

  • Proactively identify early signals of churn risk and implement effective mitigation strategies.

  • Establish a consistent engagement cadence with customer stakeholders to understand institutional priorities, regulatory obligations, and emerging risks, proactively addressing challenges before they escalate.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience, ideally within crypto businesses, or financial institutions — preferably in compliance, investigative, or customer-facing functions.

  • High proficiency in English is required. Polish language skills are desirable.

  • Hands-on experience with virtual currencies and blockchain analytics, ideally within a compliance or investigative context; strong appetite to deepen expertise in these areas is essential.

  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, prioritize critical issues, and deliver actionable solutions.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and rigor, particularly in regulatory and investigative contexts.

  • Ability to distill and communicate complex technical and investigative concepts to diverse stakeholders, from compliance officers to senior executives.

  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments where regulatory expectations and priorities evolve quickly.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings

  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for in-person meetings, trainings, or events.

About the Team

  • Our globally distributed Customer Success team collaborates across time zones. This team operates primarily on EMEA time, with occasional later calls to cover US East/West Coast stakeholders on complex opportunities.

  • We work asynchronously by default, with strong documentation and transparent Slack communication.

  • We support customers from onboarding through deep investigations, and our Deployment Strategists are the frontline champions of TRM’s value.

  • This role is an opportunity to scale impactful customer interactions and help shape how we deliver rapid, high-quality support at TRM Labs.

Learn About TRM Speed in This Role

  • Real-Time Client Response: You’ll triage and resolve customer questions during time-sensitive events such as sanctions updates or critical investigations.

  • Expedited Trace Validation: You’ll coordinate with internal teams to validate traces and gather intelligence within hours, ensuring accuracy and speed.

  • Continuous Global Coverage: You’ll contribute to TRM’s 24-hour global support model, ensuring customers always have timely, high-quality assistance no matter their region.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

description_html:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

The role is designed for law graduates who are pursuing a doctorate (Promotion) or preparing for the (Zweite) Juristische Prüfung and want hands-on in-house experience in a regulated investment firm alongside their academic work. You will work closely with our lawyers and take on increasing responsibility over time.

What you’ll do:

  • Support our Legal Team on domestic and international projects, in particular by reviewing and preparing first drafts of cooperation agreements with clients and partners.

  • Research legal questions raised by our Product, Project Management and Sales teams and prepare concise memos, with a focus on financial services regulation (e.g. WpIG, MiFID II, DORA).

  • Conduct initial legal reviews and risk assessments of vendor agreements and summarise the key points for the responsible lawyer.

  • Help develop and maintain our standard contracts, templates, playbooks and other key legal documents essential to operations.

  • Maintain and structure our contract inventory (contract management database) to ensure completeness, compliance and clear ownership.

  • Collaborate closely with the Legal Team to automate, operationalise and improve internal processes, including with AI-based legal tech tools.

  • Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Upvest (e.g. Bafin, ESMA, EU legislation) and prepare short briefings for the team.

What you bring:

  • A completed first German law degree (Erste Juristische Prüfung, LL.B. or LL.M). You are pursuing or planning a doctorate (Promotion) or are currently a Rechtsreferendar:in.

  • First practical experience (internships, Referendariat stations, student assistant or research assistant roles), ideally in an international and fast-paced environment, is a plus but not required.

  • A keen interest in financial services, capital markets or regulatory law – ideally reflected in your studies, dissertation topic or first practical experience.

  • Enthusiasm for an agile and proactive working culture.

  • Very good communication skills with fluency in business English and German (the working language of our international team is English). Strong intercultural awareness and enthusiasm for working in a global environment.

  • A team-oriented spirit, with a passion for cross-disciplinary collaboration.

  • Confident use of Google Workspace, MS Office and AI tools, and curiosity about legal tech.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description_html:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

Are you passionate about creating intuitive digital experiences that empower millions of entrepreneurs?

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Jimdo's products by designing seamless, accessible, and impactful customer experiences across web and mobile platforms. Reporting to the Head of Experience Design, you'll lead end-to-end product design—from discovery and research through delivery—working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Data teams, and AI specialists.

You'll combine systems thinking, strategic product design, customer insights, and emerging AI design practices to solve meaningful customer problems while helping raise the overall design maturity across the organization through collaboration and mentorship.

 

Your impact:

  • Lead end-to-end product design across discovery, ideation, prototyping, validation, and delivery.

  • Conduct generative and evaluative user research, usability testing, customer interviews, and Jobs-to-be-Done discovery to uncover customer needs.

  • Design elegant, accessible, and responsive experiences across desktop and mobile using modern design systems and WCAG best practices.

  • Create high-quality interaction designs, prototypes, information architecture, and visual experiences that drive customer value.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Data, and AI teams to influence product strategy and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

  • Design and prototype AI-powered experiences, conversational interfaces, and AI-assisted workflows while promoting responsible AI design.

  • Contribute to design systems and design operations, and continuously improve design quality, processes, and team practices.

What you bring:

  • 5–8 years of experience designing digital SaaS products, with ownership across the full product lifecycle.

  • Strong expertise in UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, information architecture, usability testing, and systems thinking.

  • Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative user research and translating insights into impactful product solutions.

  • Deep proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools, alongside experience working with design systems.

  • Proven success collaborating within cross-functional Agile product teams alongside Product Managers and Engineers.

  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills that help elevate teams and influence product direction.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted or AI-powered product experiences is highly desirable.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity, with an Employee-led DEI Council and active ERGs that ensure everyone's voices are heard.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package: 

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced diversity and inclusion efforts across the recruiting journey.

  • Champion cross-team alignment, ensuring seamless stakeholder communication, onboarding, and process excellence from sourcing through hiring.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. RV Tech is redefining what a car can be by making continuous iteration and improvement core to the product. Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates are what make that model possible — allowing us to seamlessly and rapidly deliver the latest software to both engineering and customer vehicles. As a result, the OTA system sits on the critical path of RV Tech's entire development chain.

As Manager of OTA Vehicle Engineering Berlin, you will lead and grow the Berlin chapter of RV Tech’s OTA team so that they may develop end to end features within the broader OTA ecosystem and support the Volkswagen Group directly in our joint effort to build a software defined vehicle.

title: Customer Success Application Engineer (EMEA)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Litmus
description_html:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus products for customers across EMEA.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Validate customer requirements for proof-of-concept and production implementations of Litmus products.

  • Configure Litmus products during proof-of-concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments.

  • Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.

  • Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products.

  • Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation.

  • Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution.

  • Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales-to-implementation handovers.

  • Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities.

  • Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • Professional experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment, ideally in an Application Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, Controls, Industrial IT/OT, or related technical role.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or supporting software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments.

  • Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or technical support activities.

  • Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Partner Success Manager is a key role within the Litmus Customer Success team, focused on supporting and strengthening relationships with our partner network. This role ensures Litmus partners are equipped to successfully deploy, support, and promote Litmus software using established Litmus best practices and processes.

As a trusted advisor, you’ll help partners understand Litmus product capabilities, adopt new features, follow deployment standards, and deliver a high-quality customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, partner-facing role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work with partner teams both remotely and on-site.

The Partner Success Manager reports to the Vice President of Customer Success and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partner, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

Travel to partner locations will be required.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary engagement contact for assigned Litmus partners, building strong relationships across technical, implementation, and leadership teams.

  • Lead partner onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to ensure partners are confident using and supporting Litmus products.

  • Educate partners on best practices for deployment, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout partner-led implementations and customer deployments, including managing escalations and resolving complex challenges.

  • Showcase new Litmus features, product enhancements, and platform capabilities to partner teams.

  • Identify gaps in partner knowledge, technical readiness, or process adherence and develop plans to address them.

  • Monitor partner engagement, deployment quality, and overall satisfaction.

  • Gather partner feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, documentation, and product adoption.

  • Work cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, and Engineering teams to drive successful outcomes.

  • Travel to partner sites as needed for training, business reviews, technical workshops, and relationship-building meetings.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in partner management, customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, training and enablement, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

  • Professional experience within manufacturing, industrial technology, industrial automation, IIoT, or a related industrial environment.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand, explain, and guide software deployment and implementation processes.

  • Experience working with enterprise software, industrial software, IIoT, IoT platforms, data platforms, cloud technologies, or related technologies.

  • Experience training customers, partners, or internal teams on software products and processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.

  • Experience with Wrike.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex deployment or process-related challenges.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Partner, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering teams.

description_html:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Als HR Business Partner (m/f/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere mittlerweile mehr als 400 Mitarbeiter, sowohl in unserem HQ in Berlin, als auch in unseren deutschlandweiten Portfoliounternehmen. Da wir monatlich durch Zukäufe von Hausverwaltungen wachsen, wächst deine Verantwortung schnell. Um die Rolle optimal ausfüllen zu können, benötigst du starkes prozessuales Verständnis, arbeitsrechtliche Expertise, sowie eine unternehmerisch geprägte Arbeits- und Denkweise.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du entwickelst deutschlandweite HR Systeme. Du erfindest die People Systeme, die uns ermöglichen auf >1,000 Mitarbeiter zu wachsen und rollst sie aus.

  • Du managest unser Personalsystem Personio, das deutschlandweit im Einsatz ist, und stellst mit deinem zukünftigen Team sicher, dass eine hohe Datenqualität gegeben ist.

  • Du triffst Geschäftsführer unserer Unternehmen und besprichst Personalthemen mit diesen. Du verbesserst die HR Prozesse unserer Unternehmen deutschlandweit.

  • Du berätst unser HQ Leadership und unser Property Management Team in allen arbeitsrechtlichen Themen.

Du passt, wenn du

  • Lust hast, das HR-Department für 400 Mitarbeiter von Grund auf aufzubauen

  • Über drei Jahre Vollzeit Arbeitserfahrung im HR mitbringst und Prozesse von Null aufgebaut und volle Verantwortung dafür übernommen hast.

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre in einem high-growth Umfeld, wie einem VC-finanzierten Startup oder PE-finanzierten Unternehmen gearbeitet hast.

  • Sehr ambitioniert bist und du gerne dein eigenes Team aufbauen würdest.

  • Muttersprachlich Deutsch sprichst.

  • In-Office arbeiten möchtest.

Deine Benefits

  • Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

  • MacBook & Studio Display.

  • Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus. 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit ~25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

  • Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

  • Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf: Die Wohneigentumsquote in Deutschland liegt weit unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Wir ändern das.

title: Portfolio Growth Lead (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Buena
description_html:
About Buena

Buena is building the technology that real estate runs on. We're making every part of real estate as seamless and transparent as possible, whether that's finding, financing, buying or managing an apartment. We do this by acquiring property managers across Germany and rebuilding them as technology companies. In under two years and with fewer than 25 people at our HQ, we've already become Germany's second-largest property manager

About the role

We're looking for a Portfolio Growth Lead (m/f/d) who will directly report to our VP Property Management. In this pivotal role, you will design the growth engine driving all of our property managers' core business revenue. In your first 90 days, you'll be hands-on across direct sales, partnerships and online marketing channels. By the end of your first 180 days, you'll have a repeatable playbook. After a year, you will generate millions in euros of topline revenue growth for our companies across Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Build the growth playbook from zero. There's nothing you're inheriting. You'll decide what growth experiments you run.

  • Full-Cycle Sales. Your role starts with generating leads and ends with turning them into signed property management contracts.

  • Report directly to the VP Property Management. You'll be in close exchange with our VP Property Management and C-Level.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Speak fluent German (C2). Our PortCos operate locally, and our customers are German homeowners.

  • Are based in Berlin or willing to relocate; this is an in-office role in Prenzlauer Berg

  • Are up for traveling to our PortCos. We build mini-tech companies all across Germany. You should be up for spending time with the local MDs.

  • You've got proven sales expertise. You've brought sales for any kind of product or service from 0->1. Ideally, repeatedly.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: You're energized by being the first growth hire and building the playbook from scratch.

Your Benefits

  • Up to €500 close-to-office bonus, if you decide to live within 10-20 mins walking distance to our office.

  • €110/month lunch budget, €50 fitness subsidy.

  • €1,200 yearly education budget.

  • Free books: Buena pays for any book you'd like to read.

Why you should apply now

  • We're high-growth with a small, tight-knit team: Within the past 3 years we have become Germany's second largest property manager with around 20 full-time employees.

  • We're meritocratic: Your impact gets rewarded, quickly. Our CEO has been a Junior Product Manager 3 years ago, our COO has been Chief of Staff 2 years ago.

  • We're personal: We work from our office in Prenzlauer Berg and place high value on knowing each other well.

description_html:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

title: Senior Security and Compliance Engineer (m/f/d)

description_html:
About Codesphere

Codesphere is a Virtual Cloud Provider from Germany building the future of sovereign cloud infrastructure. Our platform gives enterprises and governments full sovereignty without giving up modern cloud capability – a vision recently validated by a series of multi-million European government tenders.

Since our founding in Karlsruhe in 2020, we’ve expanded into an international team of 60+ experts. Based in Karlsruhe and Munich and backed by top-tier investors, we are chasing a bold vision.

We’re scaling fast and would love for you to join us and grow alongside us 🚀

About the role

Codesphere runs cloud infrastructure that enterprises and governments depend on – security is not an afterthought, it's a foundation. As a Senior Security & Compliance Engineer (m/f/d), you own the security posture of our platform: from vulnerability management and incident response to compliance frameworks and developer enablement.

What you'll drive

  • You conduct security assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability scanning – and drive remediation with development teams

  • You manage security scanning tooling (DAST/SAST) and perform security code reviews

  • You design and implement security controls across our full technology stack, defining and enforcing standards for development, infrastructure, and data

  • You integrate security into our CI/CD pipelines and development processes – Shift Left and DevSecOps in practice, not just on paper

  • You develop and maintain our Security Incident Response Plan, monitor security logs via SIEM, and lead forensic analysis when needed

  • You ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations – including GDPR and ISO 27001

  • You manage IAM systems with a least privilege approach

  • You develop and deliver security awareness training for the whole company – and specialised secure coding training for engineering teams

What makes you a great fit

  • 5+ years in a security engineering or similar role, ideally in a cloud or SaaS environment

  • Hands-on experience with penetration testing, vulnerability management, and DAST/SAST tooling

  • Solid understanding of DevSecOps principles and CI/CD security integration

  • Familiarity with SIEM tools, incident response, and forensic analysis

  • Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks – GDPR, ISO 27001, and ideally BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Strong communicator – able to translate security risks into clear guidance for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus given the nature of our compliance landscape

What's in it for you

  • 32 days of paid time off – 30 regular vacation days plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off

  • Meal allowance – up to 15 digital vouchers per month, adding up to over €100 net for you

  • Flexibility – hybrid work setup with mobile work options and flexibility around core hours

  • Steep learning curve – fast-moving environment, real ownership, and a front-row seat to scaling a company

  • Job-Rad – lease a bike through us, tax-free

  • Gym access – stay active on site (Karlsruhe office only)

  • Employee events – from team offsites to regular get-togethers

  • Company pension scheme – company-supported pension to set you up for later

  • Great public transport links – both offices are within walking distance of tram and metro stops

About Codesphere

Codesphere is a Virtual Cloud Provider from Germany building the future of sovereign cloud infrastructure. Our platform gives enterprises and governments full sovereignty without giving up modern cloud capability – a vision recently validated by a series of multi-million European government tenders.

Since our founding in Karlsruhe in 2020, we’ve expanded into an international team of 60+ experts. Based in Karlsruhe and Munich and backed by top-tier investors, we are chasing a bold vision.

We’re scaling fast and would love for you to join us and grow alongside us 🚀

About the role

Codesphere is entering complex, high-stakes regulated markets where winning a tender requires much more than project management. As our Technical Bid Manager, you own the end-to-end bid process and actively shape the proposal itself – translating complex requirements into a clear response strategy and turning technical expertise into a compelling, compliant, and credible offer.

This is not a coordination role. You understand the scope in depth, challenge requirements, develop solution concepts, and write substantial parts of the proposal yourself.

What you'll drive

  • You own the complete tender lifecycle – from qualification and bid strategy through proposal development, submission, clarification rounds, and handover after award

  • You analyse tender documents and translate technical, commercial, contractual, and compliance requirements into a structured response and execution plan

  • You identify gaps against our product capabilities and work with Product and Engineering on viable solution approaches

  • You develop key parts of the proposal yourself – executive summaries, solution descriptions, implementation approaches, and responses to evaluation criteria

  • You turn complex topics around cloud platforms, PaaS, Kubernetes, security, and digital sovereignty into precise and convincing tender responses

  • You coordinate and challenge contributions from Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and external partners to ensure one consistent, complete proposal

  • You build reusable templates and evidence libraries, and feed recurring market requirements back into Product Strategy

What makes you a great fit

  • Experience with complex B2B, enterprise, or public-sector tenders, solution design, or technical proposals in software, cloud, or platform environments

  • Strong technical background – able to work effectively with engineers, architects, and product teams and hold your own in deeply technical discussions

  • Solid understanding of cloud concepts: SaaS/PaaS/IaaS, Kubernetes, DevOps, CI/CD, managed services, IAM, and security

  • Exceptional writing skills – able to create concise, precise, and persuasive content from complex and sometimes incomplete source material

  • Highly organized under hard deadlines, with the ability to maintain a clear view of the overall solution and bid strategy

  • Confident stakeholder management – you challenge senior leaders and subject-matter experts when contributions are incomplete

What you'll tell people you are part of

  • You'll work on tenders that shape infrastructure powering some of Europe's most critical institutions – from the German Federal Government to leading enterprises.

  • You’ll join early enough to shape a category that didn't exist before, late enough to know it's real.

…on top of that

  • 32 days of paid time off – 30 regular vacation days plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off

  • Meal allowance – up to 15 digital vouchers per month, adding up to over €100 net for you

  • Flexibility – hybrid work setup with mobile work options and flexibility around core hours

  • Steep learning curve – fast-moving environment, real ownership, and a front-row seat to scaling a company

title: Account Executive II DACH
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Pleo
description_html:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our DACH Sales Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals and be part of a collaborative and successful sales unit as we scale Pleo's expense management solution. If you're excited about converting new business and are passionate about SaaS outbound sales this is the opportunity for you!

What you'll be doing

As an Account Executive, you will:

  • Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion

  • Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships

  • Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo

  • Become an expert in expense management

  • Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A track record of meeting sales quotas and targets - ideally including sourcing and closing your own deals

  • Great rapport building and confident presentation skills

  • Strong ability to accept feedback and adapt to new situations

  • Experience in outbound sales

  • Background in SaaS sales is preferred - ideally coming from an Account Executive closing role

  • Fluency in English and German

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Sales Manager and work closely with teams in SDRs, Customer Success and Marketing. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to achieving revenue goals. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across product to ensure success

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Close your first key deals to drive impact in new business revenue

  • Build your own pipeline

  • Grow your skills in SaaS sales and expense management, taking on new challenges as Pleo continues to scale

Show the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

  • Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

  • In the UK, we offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Sales team we offer hybrid working, with up to two days a week from home three days a week in the London office

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We’re trialling MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kuro Technology
description_html:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.

  • The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

  • Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.

  • Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.

After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As Product Manager, you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.

Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.

 

What You'll Do

  • Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.

  • Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.

  • Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.

  • Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.

  • Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.

  • Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.

  • Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.

  • Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.

  • Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

Bonus:

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.

  • Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.

  • Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.

 

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers, and 3D project graphs. Kuro Product Vision →

 

The process

  1. Talent Acquisition Call — Intro, logistics & fit (30 min)

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive with Jonas & Get to know Product (30 min)

  3. Challenge: A time-boxed product challenge (≤4 hours)

  4. Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

  5. On-site Day — Meet the team and lunch/dinner

    • Culture Interview (30 Min)

    • Meet several team members

    • Go for lunch with the team

  6. Decision

Compensation: €85K – €110K • 0.05% – 0.15%

  • • €85K – €110K • 0.05% – 0.15%

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €8 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 3+ years of experience as a (full-stack) software engineer in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers and 3D project graphs. Explore Kuro Engineering →

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (60 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

title: Head of Marketing (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Ostrom
description_html:
🌐 We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform to provide fair, clean energy to everyone. ⚡

We’re a diverse team of 50+ employees, with 46% being female and from 16+ nationalities, and steadily growing. Having raised of over €40 M in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission! 🚀

🇩🇪 Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um faire und saubere Energie für alle zugänglich zu machen. ⚡

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über 50 Personen aus mehr als 16 Nationalitäten, mit einem Frauenanteil von 46 %. Und wir wachsen weiter!
Mit über 40 Mio. € an Finanzierung suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen. 🚀

Über Ostrom

Ostrom ist der digital-first Ökostromanbieter aus Berlin. Wir machen Energie einfach, transparent und fair: gute Preise, eine App, die wirklich funktioniert, und smarte Features wie Smartes Laden, dynamische Tarife und intelligente Verbrauchssteuerung. Über unser Virtuelles Kraftwerk (VPP) vernetzen wir tausende Haushalte zu einem flexiblen Energiesystem und machen so aus jedem Zuhause einen Teil der Energiewende. Energie. Einfach Besser.
Wir wachsen schnell, sind von namhaften internationalen VCs finanziert und auf dem Weg zum profitablen Wachstum. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden in Berlin, der unser Marketing auf das nächste Level bringt.

Die Rolle

Als Head of Marketing (m/w/d) verantwortest du unsere Neukundengewinnung und unsere Marke. Du entwickelst die Strategie, baust das Team auf und treibst das Wachstum über alle Kanäle voran. In dieser Senior-Leadership-Rolle übernimmst du echte Verantwortung: Du berichtest direkt an unseren Gründer und CEO, führst das Marketing-Team und hast echte Budgetverantwortung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du definierst und steuerst Ostroms Marketingstrategie über Brand, Performance, Preisvergleichsportale, D2D, Social und CRM

  • Du verantwortest unsere Unit Economics mit sehr klarem Fokus auf kanalübergreifende(r) CAC-Optimierung, CAC-Payback und LTV/CAC in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Finance

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produkt- und Operations-Team an neuen Produktlaunches

  • Du entwickelst und führst unser schlankes und leistungsstarkes Marketingteam

  • Du treibst die Einführung von AI-Tools im gesamten Marketing voran und findest die Use Cases mit dem größten Hebel (Personalisierung, Predictive Analytics)

  • Du bleibst hands-on und treibst Kerninitiativen eigenständig voran

Das bringst du mit

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing, davon mindestens 3 in einer Führungsrolle - idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up, Scale-up oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld

  • Du arbeitest extrem datenbasiert, kannst relevante Marketing- und Business-Daten analysieren, verständlich visualisieren und daraus klare Entscheidungen ableiten

  • Du bist interessiert moderne Tools, KI und Automatisierung zu nutzen, um Marketing smarter und effizienter zu machen. Vorkenntnisse sind kein muss - wir suchen vor allem Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an neuen Technologien.

  • Du hast B2C-Consumer-Brands skaliert, idealerweise in Energie, Fintech (Banking/Insurance) oder vergleichbaren Branchen

  • Starkes Verständnis für Brand- und Performance-Marketing, mit Hands-on-Erfahrung in der kanalübergreifenden Steuerung, Optimierung und Erfolgsmessung

  • Sehr gutes wirtschaftliches Verständnis: Du denkst in Unit Economics, Margen und Customer Lifetime Value

  • Absolutes Muss: fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2, idealerweise auf muttersprachlichem Niveau), sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift

  • Builder-Mindset: Du kommst gut mit Unklarheit zurecht, priorisierst klar und bringst Dinge pragmatisch voran

  • Klare, souveräne Kommunikation, schriftlich und persönlich

Nice-to-Have

  • Erfahrung im Energiesektor

  • Erfahrung im Start-up, Scale-up Umfeld

🌐 About Us

We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp™ , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive.

How? Through variable tariffs, dynamic pricing, smart EV charging, heat pump and solar optimization, and Germany’s first virtual power plant: NeoGrid™.

At Ostrom, you’ll work in a dynamic, open environment where you can be yourself, take on challenges, and grow both personally and professionally.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Finto
description_html:
About Finto

Finto is on a mission to reinvent how enterprises run their finance operations. Starting with AI-powered automation for accounts payable, we eliminate manual invoice handling, supplier chasing, 3-Way-Matching and ERP data entry. Backed by Y Combinator, we're building the future of enterprise accounting.

Our mission is to free the world's finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, partnering with our customers, or shaping our story: We just make things finance teams want.

About the role

We are hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence to work directly with our CTO. You will take ownership of important, loosely defined problems and deliver results.

Your initial focus will be customer integrations and solution engineering. You will lead strategic customer initiatives, translate recurring needs into product direction, and help reduce the time our CTO spends on solution scoping. As you prove ownership, your scope can expand into product discovery, internal engineering, or AI adoption.

This is a hands-on role. You will build, investigate, make decisions, and follow through. It is not a support or project-management position.

What you’ll do

Lead strategic customer initiatives

Own important customer engagements from discovery through delivery. Join technical conversations, clarify requirements, and act as the CTO’s delegate where agreed. Turn recurring customer needs into clear input for the product roadmap.

Drive product and technical discovery

Turn open questions into specifications and prototypes. Evaluate whether we should build, buy, or integrate. Research technical options and recommend a clear course of action.

Improve how our engineers work

Remove friction from onboarding, permissions, tooling, and internal infrastructure. Build secure, self-service workflows that help engineers work effectively.

Lead practical AI adoption

Test new AI tools and workflows across Finto. Measure whether they improve speed or quality, train the team on useful applications, and introduce appropriate guardrails.

Your priorities will change as the company changes. One week you may scope an ERP integration. The next, you may prototype a product idea or improve an internal workflow.

What we’re looking for

  • You have built something from scratch and taken responsibility for the outcome.

  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You can understand software architecture, build prototypes, and work with modern AI and LLM tools.

  • You are familiar with Node.js, TypeScript, and integration-heavy systems.

  • You have worked at startup speed, whether as a founder, early engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or in a Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff role.

  • You communicate clearly in German and English.

  • You want to take on more responsibility as you grow.

Experience with ERP integrations, fintech, developer tooling, or customer-facing technical work is helpful but not required.

Working at Finto

  • Work with the founders on problems that directly affect customers and the company.

  • Take ownership early. Your scope will grow with the results you deliver.

  • Join our in-office team in Munich five days per week.

  • Receive 25 vacation days and two company-wide recharge days.

  • Build relationships through Finto’s Y Combinator and San Francisco network.

Interview process

  1. Introductory call: 20 minutes with our CEO

  2. Technical call: 30 minutes with our CTO

  3. Working session: 90-minute technical challenge

  4. Culture interview with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

  • • €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

title: SAP Integration Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Finto
description_html:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

  • Fulltime • €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
