description_html:
What We’re Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to take full ownership of new robotic subsystems from first idea to production-ready hardware. You combine strong mechanical design skills with practical lab experience and a keen sense for manufacturability. Above all, you're someone who doesn't wait to be told what's next. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and enjoy working openly in a fast-moving, international team that's growing together.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions. You believe the best work happens in an environment where people support each other, share knowledge, and grow together.

What You’ll Build

  • Own the full development cycle of robotic subsystems, from concept through rapid prototyping, iterative improvement, and deployment

  • Design complex mechanical systems and integrate mechanical and electrical components into functional robotics solutions

  • Build and test prototypes hands-on, including assembly, troubleshooting, and iterative validation

  • Collaborate with the electronics and software team on system integration and performance

  • Optimize designs for manufacturability and assembly to enable scalable production

  • Manage outsourcing partners and suppliers to transition prototypes into production-ready systems

What You Bring

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or related field

  • 3+ years experience in automation/robotics, with strong track record designing complex electromechanical systems, from prototype to production

  • Hands-on mindset with a passion for building, testing, and troubleshooting real-world systems and solid CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion)

  • Proven experience of optimizing designs in compact electromechanical systems, environmental sealing, and design for manufacturing

  • Experience with manufacturing, supplier collaboration, and design for scalable production

  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You naturally identify what needs to happen next, collaborate openly in an international team, and are eager to grow alongside it

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We help you find an apartment in the Werksviertel within walking distance of the office. We connect you with the right contacts and take the stress out of apartment hunting.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

title: IT Administrator
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Cosuno
description_html:
Your mission

You'll be the first dedicated IT Administrator at Cosuno and the go-to person for all things IT for our 100-person team. From setting up laptops for new joiners to managing accounts and access in our SaaS tooling stack, you'll make sure everyone at Cosuno can simply sit down and work.

Today, IT support is handled on the side by our tech leadership. Your job is to take it over, put simple and reliable processes around it, and give our team an IT experience that just works.

What you'll do

Device management

  • Set up, maintain, repair, and replace laptops (Mac and Windows) for the whole company

  • Manage our device fleet through JumpCloud (MDM): enrollment, updates, configuration profiles, and security baselines

  • Keep our hardware inventory accurate and manage the lifecycle from purchase to secure disposal

Onboarding & offboarding

  • Run the IT side of joiner/mover/leaver processes: accounts, hardware, access rights, all ready on day one and cleanly removed on the last day

  • Continuously improve and automate these processes so they scale with the company

Accounts & SaaS administration

  • Administer user accounts, groups, and SSO across our SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and more)

  • Execute access requests and support periodic access reviews together with our Security team

IT support

  • Be the first point of contact for IT questions and problems, in the office and remotely

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, accounts, and connectivity issues, and document solutions so they're reusable

  • Support office IT: meeting room equipment, printers, WiFi, and event tech when needed

How we work

  • Ownership from day one: IT support is yours. You decide how to organize it, with the backing of our CTO and Security team.

  • Structure over firefighting: We'd rather you fix a problem once and automate or document it than fix it ten times. Building simple, self-service processes is part of the job.

  • AI as a daily tool: We use AI tools like Claude across the company, including in IT. Whether it's drafting documentation, writing a small script, or troubleshooting an unusual error, we expect you to use AI actively to work faster and smarter.

  • Close to Security: You'll work hand in hand with our Security & Compliance function. They define policies for devices and access; you put them into practice.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Fluent German and English. You'll support colleagues in both languages every day.

  • Hands-on experience in IT support or IT administration, ideally in a company running on Macs and SaaS tools

  • Experience with an MDM and/or identity provider (JumpCloud, Jamf, Kandji, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar), or the demonstrated ability to learn tools like these quickly

  • A service mindset. You're friendly, responsive, and patient, and you take pride in colleagues being unblocked quickly.

  • A structured way of working. You keep track of open tickets, document what you do, and follow through.

  • Comfort with light scripting or automation (shell, Python, or low-code tools), or the motivation to build this skill, ideally with AI assistance

Bonus points for:

  • Experience administering Google Workspace and Slack

  • Experience with hardware lifecycle management and IT asset inventory

  • Basic networking knowledge (WiFi, VPN, DNS)

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or other security frameworks (access reviews, device compliance)

  • Experience in a fast-growing startup environment

Practical details

This role is based in Berlin with regular presence in our office, since a core part of the job is hands-on: setting up devices, helping colleagues in person, and keeping office IT running. Outside of that, we're flexible about hours and remote days.

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll build the IT function of a Series C company from the ground up and shape how 100 people work every day.

description_html:
Your mission

As a member of our Data team, you'll take full ownership of the systems that turn raw data into decisions—for our product, our internal teams, our customers, and our investors. You won't just maintain dashboards; you'll own the pipeline end to end, from ingestion to the numbers people actually act on.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our dbt pipeline, improving our data models so they're reliable, well-tested, and easy to build on.

  • Maintain and extend our Looker setup, and ship new dashboards and reports that customers and other stakeholders depend on.

  • Strengthen our data pipeline from Postgres to BigQuery, and build custom Python scripts to automate the flows that keep our warehouse fresh.

  • Integrate our data warehouse with external tools like Salesforce or ActiveCampaign, so the right data reaches the teams that need it.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our people and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Ownership Over Handoffs: On a small data team, you own your work from ingestion to dashboard. We trust you to make decisions and run with them.

  • Quality by Default: We treat our data models like production code—tested, version-controlled, and documented—so the numbers we serve are ones we can stand behind.

  • DevOps Mindset: We automate the boring parts. Pipelines, syncs, and checks are powered by third-party tools or GitHub Actions so the team can focus on the work that needs a human.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

  • AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools, and they're a core part of how we build—from writing models and scripts to debugging pipelines and exploring data. We expect everyone on the team to use them fluently and keep getting better at it.

Your profile

We're looking for an experienced data practitioner who likes owning the full stack of an analytics platform. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Significant professional experience building and maintaining data models with dbt and writing advanced SQL.

  • Solid Python skills for data syncing, automation, and general scripting.

  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort working with source databases like Postgres.

  • Experience building dashboards and serving data to non-technical stakeholders (a strong command of Looker is a big plus).

  • Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI coding tools—especially Claude Code—and a habit of using them as part of your daily workflow.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving and a high sense of ownership, feeling comfortable driving projects independently.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience with reverse ETL or integrating a data warehouse with tools like ActiveCampaign or Salesforce.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD or automation pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions).

  • Experience preparing data and reporting for external audiences such as customers or investors.

  • An interest in data engineering best practices, pipeline reliability, and infrastructure-as-code.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

title: Technical Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Cosuno
description_html:
Your mission

The future of construction software isn't a single closed platform — it's a connected ecosystem. As our Technical Product Manager for Integrations, you'll own how Cosuno connects to the third-party systems our customers already rely on, from estimating and ERP tools like RIB iTWO to the open REST API that lets others build on top of us. You'll be the bridge between our customers, our engineers, and our platform — turning real-world integration needs into a roadmap that makes Cosuno the infrastructure the construction industry plugs into.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in our Product team. Both our REST API and our connectors are still early, so you won't just maintain an integration surface — you'll shape it. You'll spend real time on-site with customers, understand how their systems actually work, and translate that into a product that lets them connect to Cosuno as seamlessly as possible.

In your first few months, you might:

  • Take ownership of our integrations product area — the REST API and our existing connectors to third-party systems such as RIB iTWO — and define where they go next.

  • Travel to customers across Germany to support them hands-on with implementing and setting up connectors, and to understand their systems, data flows, and constraints in the real world.

  • Sit down with customers to elicit integration requirements, then prioritize them against impact, effort, and our platform strategy.

  • Translate those requirements into clear, well-scoped tickets that our engineers can pick up and build — with the technical context they need to move fast.

  • Work through our API documentation and test endpoints yourself to validate what's possible, spot gaps, and represent the developer experience from the outside in.

  • Partner with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to make sure customers can connect their systems to Cosuno with as little friction as possible.

How we work

At Cosuno, we give people real ownership and trust them to do their best work. For this role, that means:

  • High autonomy, high impact: You'll own the integrations area end to end. No one will look over your shoulder, but you'll always have the support of the Product and Engineering teams when you need it.

  • Close to the customer: This is not a desk-only PM role. A meaningful part of your time is spent with customers on-site.

  • Technical by nature: You'll work directly with APIs, documentation, and connector behavior. You don't have to ship production code, but you do need to be comfortable in technical territory.

  • Platform thinking: We're building the infrastructure other construction tools and AI agents connect into. Every integration decision feeds that bigger picture.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in both our product and our daily work, and we want people who do the same.

Your profile

You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, or developer-facing products.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and integrations — you understand how REST APIs work, can read and reason about API documentation, and are comfortable validating endpoints (e.g. with tools like Postman) yourself.

  • A talent for working directly with customers: eliciting requirements, asking the right questions, and earning trust in technical conversations.

  • The ability to translate messy, real-world integration needs into prioritized, well-scoped tickets that engineers can act on.

  • Strong analytical thinking and a pragmatic instinct for turning complex problems into workable solutions.

  • Fluent German (this is a firm requirement — all of our customers are German construction companies and you'll work with them directly and on-site) and fluent English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customers within Germany.

  • You use AI tools — LLM-based assistants, MCPs, no-code prototyping — routinely in your day-to-day work.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with construction tech, ERP, or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

  • A background as a solutions engineer, integration engineer, or technical consultant before or alongside product management.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our modern office in Berlin Friedrichshain. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & Feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About the Team

We are hiring a Partnerships Manager based in Germany with primary responsibility for Germany. You will own some of OpenAI’s most important business development and partnerships in the German market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities. The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and executing partnership strategies that accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s products across enterprise, developer, and consumer channels.

About the Role

You will manage relationships with strategic partners in Germany and on cross-border opportunities, ranging from global technology platforms to regional champions, including enterprise software vendors, telcos, cloud providers, and government-aligned organizations. This is a deeply cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, and Policy teams. Although the role has clear accountability for Germany, team priorities may evolve, so you must be ready to take on other markets, verticals, or partnership types.

Please note that this role is based out of our Munich office, with 3 days a week required in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own partnership strategy and execution for Germany, driving end-to-end partnership development and delivery in the market while contributing to broader EMEA and international priorities.

  • Negotiate and close strategic local and cross-border deals across commercial terms, product scope, data/privacy, brand/marketing, incentives, and expansion paths.

  • Lead senior partner relationships: build trust, align on joint value props, and manage complexity.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Policy, and regional counterparts to align roadmaps, navigate constraints, and execute partnership initiatives.

  • Bring deep knowledge of Germany and a strong point of view on country and sub-region differences across EMEA, informing prioritization, positioning, and partner selection. Apply that judgment flexibly when supporting opportunities beyond Germany or in new verticals.

  • Define success metrics and use analytical judgment to assess progress, surface risks, and communicate outcomes to internal stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management within the technology industry.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Demonstrated success leading high-impact local and international partnerships involving major technology partners, including complex cross-border work.

  • Deep understanding of the German market, combined with experience operating across multiple countries and international markets.

  • Product-savvy with the ability to engage technical stakeholders credibly and influence product direction and roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive presence.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to inform decisions and communicate impact.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, operate both independently and collaboratively, and adapt quickly across changing markets, verticals, and partnership types.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you will take ownership of protecting our product, our users, and our collaborators as we scale a fast-growing AI companionship platform. You'll work hands-on across application security, risk & compliance, and security awareness (plus keeping an eye on AI-specific threats as our product line evolves). Given the nature of our product (AI-generated content, including NSFW) you'll play a key role in keeping both our systems and our users safe, with real ownership from day one.

This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the Security Lead, with regular check-ins on priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform weekly code reviews to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of security vulnerabilities across the stack

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests, and follow through on findings

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Maintain and evolve our risk register, mapping all company services and prioritizing what's exposed

  • Support audit follow-up and keep GRC documentation up to date

Security Awareness

  • Communicate new threats to the team, document findings, and broadcast security updates company-wide

  • Run phishing simulations and security training (via Riot)

Monitoring & Coverage

  • Own the monitoring of security channels and alerts, including weekend coverage, so nothing goes unanswered

description_html:
At our company, it’s all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we’ve been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go
· FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize OVHcloud's on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, senior team, you will work on our OpenStack-based infrastructure and the Kubernetes / GitOps stack powering our customer-facing cloud. AI-assisted engineering is a first-class part of how we work – from spec-driven development and agentic coding workflows to incident response and automation. The platform is in active development, giving you real influence on the architecture, automation strategy and how we adopt AI in platform engineering. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and shape your focus based on your strengths, with a clear backbone of automation, compute lifecycle, platform engineering and AI substrate work.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and build our OpenStack-based on-premise cloud infrastructure, with the goal of bringing complete cloud environments from bare metal to production through a highly automated deployment process.

  • Develop and operate Infrastructure as Code with Ansible and Terraform as well as our Kubernetes and GitOps workflows using FluxCD / ArgoCD, supported by LLMs, agentic workflows and automated testing and review.

  • Own the lifecycle of our compute infrastructure – from bare metal, firmware and provisioning through to hypervisors and virtual compute nodes. This includes patching, migrations, host evacuation, capacity rebalancing and the automation required to keep the platform healthy.

  • Build and extend our AI substrate and self-healing capabilities, from structured knowledge bases and agentic workflows for incident triage and capacity planning to gradually turning today's manual runbooks into automated processes.

  • Design tests for non-regression, performance and security, document and package solutions, and continuously improve the platform based on telemetry, operational experience and user feedback.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner for peers across automation, platform engineering and AI tooling.

What we offer you

  • A platform genuinely in build mode, with real room to shape architectural decisions, strong ownership and a senior team where autonomy matters.

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including Claude Code and comparable agentic tooling, Markdown-based knowledge bases and room to push our engineering practices further.

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam.

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies.

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service.

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation.

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package.

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs.

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities, such as gym memberships or sports classes.

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies.

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike.

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages.


  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Platform Engineer or DevOps Engineer running production infrastructure, with strong experience in OpenStack, Kubernetes and Linux, including bare metal.

  • You have managed compute infrastructure end-to-end, from firmware / BIOS rollouts, bare-metal provisioning and hardware diagnostics to hypervisors, migrations, host evacuation, graceful drains and capacity rebalancing.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your daily work. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they meaningfully support development, testing, reviews, or operations, and you know where AI adds real value and where strong engineering expertise remains essential.

  • You are confident working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps workflows such as FluxCD or ArgoCD and understand what it takes to turn automation into robust, repeatable production systems.

  • Ideally, you write Go and/or Python and have experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider or comparable agentic coding environments. Exposure to observability, networking, compute tuning, auto-remediation, security-critical infrastructure or multi-site clouds is also a plus.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership and enjoy improving systems rather than simply keeping them running. You also enjoy sharing knowledge and can communicate complex technical topics clearly.

  • You are fluent in English, written and spoken. English is the working language of our distributed team.

Your Role💻

You'll work on the conception, automation, and operation of our platform and drive continuous improvements. You'll help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. title: AI Research Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sonarsource
description_html:
Position description

 
At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data & AI team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.
 

What you will do
  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of ML, Deep Learning, and LLMs, specifically their application to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and identify novel opportunities to enhance our products.
  • Develop Advanced AI Models: Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis.
  • Build LLM-Powered Features: Develop and implement advanced LLM-based solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual code analysis, fine-tuning models on proprietary codebases, and exploring agentic systems for automated code remediation.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful ML prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools.
  • Solid programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with core ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Familiarity with Java is a plus.
  • Proven experience in applied Machine Learning, with a strong focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP) or, ideally, Programming Language Processing (PLP).
  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM architectures and techniques, such as Fine-tuning strategies (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA), advanced prompt engineering, building and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and working with vector databases and semantic search
  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).
  • Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and a talent for explaining complex scientific topics clearly and concisely.

    •  

    Salary range

    Additional comments

    This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fact Finder
description_html:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.


Job Location

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) – B2B SaaS / eCommerce – Berlin, München, Pforzheim (Hybrid)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fact Finder
description_html:
Introduction

Als (Senior) Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst Du bei FactFinder ein eigenes Portfolio namhafter eCommerce-Kunden und verantwortest deren Entwicklung von Adoption und Value Realization bis zu Renewal und Expansion.

Dabei arbeitest Du mit anspruchsvollen Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts – B2B- wie B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – und bewegst Dich souverän zwischen operativen eCommerce-Teams, technischen Ansprechpartnern und C-Level-Stakeholdern.

FactFinder ist eine der führenden Product-Discovery-Plattformen für den europäischen eCommerce. Über 2.000 Kunden wie Douglas und SPAR erzielen mit unserer KI-gestützten Produktsuche einen Gesamt-GMV von mehr als 160 Milliarden Euro pro Jahr.

Auf einen Blick

  • Kundenportfolio: ca. 40–50 Accounts – überwiegend Mid-Market, ergänzt um Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, vorwiegend im DACH-Markt
  • Kommerzielle Verantwortung: Upsell- und Expansion-Ziele sowie Churn-Prävention und Vermeidung von Downgrades – die kommerzielle Ownership liegt bei Dir als CSM
  • Standorte: Berlin, München oder Pforzheim – hybrid mit 2–3 Office-Tagen pro Woche
  • Team & Reporting: CS-Team mit klar definierten Senioritätsleveln, Reporting an die Director Customer Success

Über FactFinder
Seit über 20 Jahren entwickelt FactFinder KI- und Machine-Learning-Technologie für Produktsuche, Navigation, Personalisierung und Produktempfehlungen im Online-Handel. Mit unserer Product Discovery Experience (PDX), dem Investor Genui im Rücken und einem neuen Management-Team starten wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase. Rund 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten an unseren Standorten in Pforzheim, Berlin, München und Stockholm.


Your mission

  • Portfolio & Customer Value: Du verantwortest ca. 40–50 Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, überwiegend im DACH-Markt – B2B- und B2C-Kunden aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen, was die Rolle besonders abwechslungsreich macht. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kunden definierst Du klare Ziele und Success-Pläne und machst den Mehrwert von FactFinder anhand relevanter KPIs messbar.
  • Upsell & Expansion: Du verantwortest Expansion in Deinem Portfolio end-to-end – von der Identifikation der Opportunity bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss, aktuell punktuell noch mit Unterstützung durch Sales. Du hast ein eigenes, portfolioabhängiges Expansion-Ziel, das direkt in Deinen variablen Anteil einfließt.
  • Retention & Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst anhand von Produktnutzung, Adoption und Kundenfeedback frühzeitig Risiken und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein. Die kommerzielle Renewal-Verantwortung liegt bei Dir – mit starker Unterstützung durch unser Sales Operations Team. Da sich unsere Verträge in der Regel automatisch verlängern, liegt Dein Fokus auf Churn-Prävention und der Vermeidung von Downgrades.
  • Business Reviews & Enablement: Du moderierst QBRs und Workshops, begleitest Feature-Rollouts und Pilotprojekte und sorgst dafür, dass Deine Kunden FactFinder erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Voice of the Customer: Du verstehst Herausforderungen und Anforderungen Deiner Kunden und übersetzt sie in klare Impulse für Product und Product Marketing. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Consulting und Support zusammen.
  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du entwickelst Playbooks, Prozesse, Reporting und KI-gestützte Workflows weiter und gestaltest unsere Customer-Success-Strukturen aktiv mit. Salesforce bildet die Grundlage für Deine datenbasierte Account-Steuerung.

So arbeitest Du im Team
Du übernimmst Deine Kunden ab Vertragsunterschrift von Sales und begleitest sie über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle. Im Alltag arbeitest Du am engsten mit unseren Business- und Technical-Consulting-Teams zusammen, die Dich beim Onboarding, bei Integrationen und bei komplexeren Fragestellungen unterstützen. Unser Service Desk übernimmt operative Tickets und Nutzungsfragen. So kannst Du Dich voll auf die strategische und kommerzielle Entwicklung Deiner Accounts konzentrieren.


Your profile

Must-have: 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung anspruchsvoller B2B-SaaS-Kunden im Customer Success, Account Management oder einem kundenorientierten SaaS-, Digital- oder Technology-Consulting-Umfeld.Erfahrung mit Mid-Market- und/oder Enterprise-Kunden und komplexen Stakeholder-Strukturen bis zur C-Level-Ebene.
  • Technisches Produktverständnis: Du verstehst Produktfunktionen, Konfigurationslogiken, APIs, Integrationen und Datenflüsse so weit, dass Du Kunden auch inhaltlich beraten und mit Product- und Consulting-Teams auf Augenhöhe arbeiten kannst. Selbst entwickeln musst Du nicht.
  • Value- und kommerzielles Denken: Du übersetzt Kundenziele in messbare Outcomes, erkennst Churn-Risiken und Wachstumspotenziale und verstehst, wie Customer Success auf Retention und Expansion einzahlt.
  • Routinierter Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Salesforce.
  • Deutsch und Englisch fließend sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb DACH je nach Kundenbedarf.

Nice-to-have:
  • Erfahrung mit eCommerce-Technologien wie Site Search, Product Discovery, Recommendation Engines, Personalisierung, PIM oder Feed Management.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Customer-Success-Prozesse sowie mit KI-gestütztem Arbeiten.
  • eCommerce- oder Search-Erfahrung ist kein Muss. Entscheidend sind Deine B2B-SaaS-Erfahrung, Dein technisches Verständnis und Deine Fähigkeit, messbaren Customer Value zu schaffen.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: fixer und erfolgsabhängiger Anteil – Dein variabler Anteil honoriert Churn-Prävention und Expansion-Erfolge in Deinem Portfolio direkt.
  • Produkt mit messbarem Impact: Unsere Kunden sehen den Effekt von FactFinder direkt in Conversion Rate und Umsatz – Du kannst den Erfolg Deiner Arbeit konkret sichtbar machen.
  • Starke Brands & echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest mit bekannten B2B- und B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – vom Mid-Market bis zum Strategic Account.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Unsere Customer-Success-Organisation entwickelt sich weiter. Du übernimmst nicht nur bestehende Prozesse, sondern kannst Playbooks, Reporting und Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Klar definierte Senioritätslevel im CS-Team – je nach Stärke und Interesse entwickelst Du Dich in Richtung strategischer Enterprise Accounts oder People Leadership.
  • Arbeitsumfeld & Benefits: Salesforce, Notion, Gong, Slack und KI-gestützte Workflows sowie 2–3 Office-Tage/Woche, 30 Urlaubstage, modernes Equipment, Mobilitätsangebote, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und weitere relevante Benefits.Bewerbungsprozess

Kein Anschreiben nötig – CV oder LinkedIn-Profil genügt.

Der Prozess
1. Kennenlernen per Video
2. Fachgespräch mit dem Hiring Manager
3. Kurzer Live-Case & Team-Kennenlernen
4. Kennenlernen CEO

description_html:
Gestalte moderne Microsoft-Infrastrukturen im Public Sector 

Du möchtest dein technisches Know-how einsetzen, weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bring deine Fähigkeiten in unsere anspruchsvollen IT-Projekte im öffentlichen Umfeld ein. 
Wir realisieren, betreiben und entwickeln moderne Microsoft-Infrastrukturen – von der technischen Umsetzung und Administration bis hin zu komplexen Transformations-, Architektur- und Beratungsprojekten. Dabei kannst du deine Erfahrung gezielt einbringen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln.


Aufgaben

  • Umsetzung, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft-Infrastrukturen
  • Installation, Konfiguration, Administration und Migration von IT-Systemen
  • Analyse technischer Anforderungen und Entwicklung passender Lösungen
  • Durchführung vonChanges, Tests und Fehleranalysen
  • Mitarbeit in IT-Projekten sowie Übernahme von Verantwortung für technische Arbeitspakete
  • Optimierung bestehender Infrastrukturen und Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer Technologien
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Konzepte und Betriebsunterlagen
  • Unterstützung bei Rollouts und im laufenden Betrieb
  • Koordination technischer Aufgaben und Abstimmung mit Kunden, Teams und weiteren Stakeholdern
  • Sicherstellung von Qualität, Dokumentation und nachhaltigem Betrieb
  • Für erfahrene Profile: Konzeption und Design von IT-Lösungen und Architekturen


Skills

Wir suchen unterschiedliche Profile und bieten drei Erfahrungslevel an: Junior, Mid-Level und Senior. Du musst daher nicht alle genannten Skills und Anforderungen erfüllen – entscheidend ist, dass dein Profil und deine Erfahrung zu einem unserer drei Level passen.  
 

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung bis hin zu fundierter Berufserfahrung im Microsoft-Umfeld oder in vergleichbaren Infrastrukturtechnologien(Windows Server, AD, GPO, Virtualisierung)
  • Kenntnisse in Automatisierung und Scripting, insbesondere PowerShell, sowie in den Bereichen Monitoring, Backupund Hochverfügbarkeit sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse in Installation, Konfiguration, Administration und Betrieb von IT-Systemen
  • Interesse an der Weiterentwicklung moderner Microsoft-Infrastrukturen und an anspruchsvollen technischen Fragestellungen
  • Erfahrung mit IT-Prozessen und idealerweise ITIL
  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Aufgaben eigenständig zu bearbeiten
  • Gute analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude daran, komplexe Problemstellungen zu lösen
  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung technischer Konzepte und Dokumentationen
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Für erfahrene Profile: 
  • Erfahrung in komplexen IT-Projekten, Architektur, Beratung oder technischer Projektsteuerung
  • Fähigkeit, Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen und Architekturen zu überführen
Technologien & Methoden: Windows Server 2016-2025 · AD · GPO · DNS · DHCP · PowerShell · VMware vSphere · Hyper-V · Serverbetrieb · Virtualisierung · Backup & Recovery · Monitoring · ITIL · BSI / ISO 27001 · 2nd bis 3rd-Level-Support · Troubleshooting · Deployment · Patch Management · Automatisierung · Infrastruktur-Design · Datacenter-Architektur · Anforderungsanalyse 

Rahmenbedingungen 
  • Anspruchsvolle Microsoft-Infrastrukturen mit hoher Bedeutung für Stabilität, Sicherheit und Verfügbarkeitim öffentlichen Umfeld
  • Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen IT-Spezialisten und interdisziplinären Projektteams
  • Arbeiten nach definierten Qualitäts-, Dokumentations- und Testvorgaben
  • Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – vom Ausbau der technischen Expertise bis zur Übernahme von Architektur- und Projektverantwortung
  • Bereitschaft zur Sicherheitsüberprüfung (SÜ2)


Was wir bieten

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben
  • Erholungszeit: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und zusätzliche arbeitsfreie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12.2026
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Jährliche Gehalts- und Bonusrunde, arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Effiziente Zusammenarbeit: Flache Hierarchien mit Duz-Kultur und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Neueste Hardware: MacBook oder Windows-Laptop sowie iPhone mit Dual-SIM
  • Zukunftssicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einem zukunftsorientierten IT-Unternehmen
  • Karriere & Entwicklung: Individuelle Förderung durch unser Laufbahnmodell, unseren konzipierten Schulungskatalog & regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche
  • Mobilität: Dienstwagen zur privaten Nutzung – auch als Elektrofahrzeug verfügbar
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Hochmoderne Büros mit ergonomischer Ausstattung in zentraler Lage mit direkter Anbindung an Bus & Bahn
  • Parkmöglichkeiten: Kostenlose Parkplätze in unmittelbarer Nähe
  • JobRad: Zuschuss zur Leasingrate
  • Team & Events: Stadionerlebnis Mainz 05, Sommerfest, Bowling, Online-Quiz & mehr
  • Mehr Informationen über uns und unsere Benefits findest Du hier: DATAGROUP in Ingelheim


Kontakt

Du hast die Wahl: Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf unter Angabe der Referenznummer (DG-RM-071) per E-Mail an ----- oder lade deine Unterlagen über unser Karriereportal hoch.

title: Working Student – European Security Programme (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ecfr
description_html:
Job Purpose

The European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR) seeks a Working Student to assist with European Security Programme’s overall event management and logistics activities and research efforts, ensuring the smooth execution of various tasks related to organizing events and research activities. This role offers hands-on experience in both research and planning and coordinating events within an international non-profit organization. Key responsibilities include managing RSVPs, coordinating catering, handling logistical arrangements, and supporting our research output. This is a great opportunity to learn the behind-the-scenes aspects of research and event management in a dynamic, multinational environment.  


Main Responsibilities

  • Assist in the organisation of events, including preparing lists of participants, sending invitations, tracking registrations, and liaising with attendees; 
  • Support with research and follow relevant debates and monitor political developments related to the programme’s work;
  • Assist in handling logistical tasks such as coordinating with venues, hotels and catering companies;
  • Monitor and respond to the general programme inbox, ensuring timely and accurate communication with partners and participants; 
  • Update and maintain the programmes contact database.


Person Specification

Education

  • Currently enrolled in Political Science, International Relations, Event Management or a related field in a German university or higher education institution. Please note that graduates are not eligible. 


Skills and Abilities

Skills

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).  
  • Strong organizational skills with an eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. 
  • Strong critical thinking, research, and analytical skills
  • Proactive and flexible attitude, with a willingness to take on varied responsibilities, including administrative and logistical tasks. 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 
 
Abilities
  • Enthusiastic and proactive approach to work  
  • Ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Adaptable and flexible with a willingness to take on varied tasks  
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multinational team


What we offer

  • Competitive monetary compensation in line with statutory minimum requirements
  • Convenient office location in the heart of Berlin
  • Stimulating and open work culture at an innovative and renowned pan-European think tank with partly hybrid work opportunities that allow flexibility while maintaining productivity and collaboration.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with highly motivated and committed colleagues from diverse backgrounds across Europe, within an organization that holds a distinguished position and wide recognition within the think tank world.


To Apply and Next steps

If this is of interest, we look forward to receiving your application!  
 
Please use the apply button to submit your cover letter and CV (max. 2 pg. and pdf format) 
 
Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany.
 
Candidates must be fluent in English 
 
We aim to keep you posted with the status of your application, but due to high volume of applicants, we are unable to communicate with all applicants individually. If you are not contacted within 2 weeks of closing date, please consider you have not been pre-selected. 
 
We care about your data privacy. If you are interested to know more about how we manage your personal data, you can find more information in this link: https://ecfr.eu/privacy-job-applicants/ 
 
ECFR is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.  
 
STRICTLY NO AGENCIES PLEASE

title: Senior Consultant (w/m/d) Policy Monitoring & Reporting  im Bereich Forschung und Innovation
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Technopolis Group
description_html:
Die Technopolis Group ist ein internationales Forschungs- und Beratungsunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor mit über 300 Kolleg*innen an zwölf Standorten in Europa, Afrika und Lateinamerika – knapp 50 davon in Deutschland und Österreich. Unser Team analysiert und gestaltet Politikprogramme für regionale, nationale und internationale öffentliche Auftraggeber*innen in den folgenden Themengebieten:

  • Forschungs- & Innovationspolitik
  • Green Economy & Klimapolitik
  • Digitale Transformation
  • Education, Skills & Employment
  • Internationale Kooperation und Entwicklungszusammenarbeit
  • Regionalentwicklung & Kohäsionspolitik
  • Entrepreneurship & Innovationsfinanzierung

Unsere Projekte reichen von Evaluationen einzelner Förderprogramme über strategische Analysen und Monitoringvorhaben bis hin zu wiederkehrenden Berichtsformaten und Beratungsforen, in denen wir belastbare Evidenzen für Entscheidungsträger*innen in Politik und öffentlichem Sektor bereitstellen.

 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine*n berufserfahrene*n Senior Consultant für die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsstellen-, Monitoring- und Berichtsformaten im Bereich Forschung und Innovation. Ihr Arbeitsschwerpunkt liegt auf der Koordination, fachlich-redaktionellen Steuerung und Mitarbeit bei der konzeptionellen Fortentwicklung solcher Formate für öffentliche Auftraggeber*innen. Sie bringen ein fundiertes Verständnis der deutschen Forschungs- und Innovationslandschaft mit und haben Freude daran, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht aufzubereiten und weiterzuentwickeln.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Kontinuierliche Beobachtung und Analyse forschungs- und innovationspolitischer Entwicklungen und deren Aufbereitung für wiederkehrende Berichts-, Monitoring- und Beratungsformate öffentlicher Auftraggeber*innen
  • Aufbereitung, Vermittlung und visuelle Darstellung statistischer Daten sowie von Indikatoren zum Forschungs- und Innovationssystem
  • Erstellung, inhaltlich-redaktionelle Koordination und Qualitätssicherung adressatengerechter Berichte, Studien und Präsentationen für ein Fachpublikum sowie die breite Öffentlichkeit – von der Konzeption über die eigenständige empirische Arbeit bis zur finalen Abstimmung mit allen Beteiligten
  • Projektmanagement, inkl. Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung innerhalb des Teams, Steuerung von Abstimmungs- und Schnittstellenprozessen mit Auftraggeber*innen und Kooperationspartner*innen


Ihr Profil

  • Mindestens vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Politikberatung und/oder Evaluation, Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projektteams und Wahrnehmung von Geschäftsstellenaufgaben wünschenswert
  • Erfahrung in der Akquise von Beratungs- und Auftragsforschungsprojekten für Organisationen in unserem Arbeitsumfeld
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von komplexen Abstimmungsprozessen mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern aus dem Wissenschaftskontext, bspw. Bundes- und Landesministerien oder Wissenschaftsorganisationen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der deutschen Forschungs- und Innovationslandschaft sowie aktueller forschungs- und innovationspolitischer Debatten
  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftsbasierter Berichte sowie in der Aufbereitung und Vermittlung statistischer Daten im Bereich Forschung und Innovation; Kenntnisse in Innovationsindikatorik und Wissenschaftsstatistik von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägte redaktionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht, klar und ausgewogen aufzubereiten
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, belastbare empirische Methodenkenntnisse; Selbständigkeit sowie eine analytische, verbindliche und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen (z. T. auch internationalen) Dienstreisen; sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil


Unser Angebot

  • Wir bieten durch die enge Projektzusammenarbeit mit öffentlichen Institutionen ein sinnstiftendes und gesellschaftlich wirkungsvolles Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Wir bieten eine unbefristete Anstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Zuschüsse zur Nutzung umweltfreundlicher Mobilitätsarten (ÖPNV oder Jobrad), für eine Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft sowie die betriebliche Altersversorgung runden das Angebot ab.
  • Wir ermöglichen eine flexible Arbeitsweise mit attraktiven Arbeitsplätzen sowie Home-Office-Möglichkeiten durch mobilfähige Ausstattung (MacBook & iPhone).
  • Als innovatives Unternehmen fördern wir die Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden über interne und externe Fortbildungsangebote. Wir fördern Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative für den Ausbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Aktivitäten durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.
  • Wir legen Wert auf eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und leben dies z.B. durch ein kollegiales, vertrauensvolles Miteinander, aber auch z.B. regelmäßige Teamevents, inkl. Events aller Kolleg*innen der Technopolis-Büros weltweit. Wir pflegen den Austausch mit unseren Schwesterbüros in Europa, Afrika und Lateinamerika.
  • Technopolis ist ausschließlich in Besitz der Mitarbeitenden, externe Investore*innen gibt es bei uns nicht. Perspektivisch können alle Mitarbeitende Anteilseigner*innen der Technopolis Group werden. Unabhängig hiervon partizipiert unser gesamtes Team regelmäßig am Unternehmenserfolg.
  • Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen, bewerben Sie sich gerne. Vielleicht sind genau Sie die richtige Person für diese Stelle. Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.


Weiteres Verfahren

Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Bitte laden Sie Ihre deutschsprachige Bewerbung (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf ohne Foto, relevante Zeugnisse sowie eine Textprobe) auf unserer Webseite unter Angabe Ihrer Standortpräferenz und Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Wunscharbeitszeit und frühestmöglichen Einstiegsdatum hoch. Für Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an unsere Recruiting Assistentin Susann Reinsch (susann.reinsch_AT_technopolis-group.com).

title: Product Owner AI (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ocumeda Ag
description_html:
Your role at Ocumeda

We are looking for a Product Owner AI (m/f/d) to take ownership of a new AI-based medical device. You will own the product's technical specification, backlog and requirements end-to-end, from feature scoping through implementation and international roll-out, acting as the central point between our medical, regulatory, and AI team. If you're motivated to take ownership of a product and shape it within a growing MedTech company, this role is for you.

  • Own the product end-to-end: from feature scoping through implementation, launch, and international roll-out
  • Translate medical and business requirements into clear technical specifications and a prioritized backlog, based on input from users, markets, and internal stakeholders
  • Support the MDR process by bringing technical and product input into Regulatory's decisions on intended use, risk, and output presentation
  • Own the software requirements specification (SRS) and work closely with our AI team to specify and integrate the MDR-certified AI system into the product
  • Work with the product team to bring the device live across multiple markets on our existing platform, adapting to local requirements where needed


What makes you a great fit

  • You have a technical background or hands-on experience with software/API specifications, and you're comfortable moving fluidly between technical AI/engineering details and the regulatory, medical, and business perspectives, translating in both directions
  • You are motivated to work hands-on in a startup environment, balancing pragmatism with structure
  • You take ownership, work in a structured way, and have the drive to push things forward, while collaborating closely with the team.
  • You collaborate closely with the medical, regulatory and AI team to ensure smooth execution and alignment.
  • You are fluent in English (additional languages are a plus, but not required)
  • You bring relevant experience in product management or a comparable role, ideally with exposure to AI products, regulated environments (e.g. MDR), or internationalization


What you can expect from us

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work with home office options
  • Subsidized Deutschlandticket (public transport pass) for employees
  • Personal learning & development budget for trainings, conferences, and professional growth
  • High level of ownership, fast decision-making, and real opportunities to help shape the company
  • Regular feedback, short decision paths, and individual development opportunities
  • International team with close collaboration, regular exchange, and shared team events
  • Collaboration with experts from optometry, ophthalmology, software & AI development, and strategy consulting
  • Monthly contribution toward a Wellpass membership
  • Free access to Nilo Health for mental health and wellbeing
  • Competitive salary matching your role and experience
  • Modern, dog-friendly office in the heart of Munich, close to the main train station (Hauptbahnhof)
  • Contributing to a leading teleophthalmology platform that sustainably improves access to eye care
  • Established B2B2C model with over 800 partner optician locations and more than 500,000 screenings performed

Deine Rolle bei Ocumeda

Als Chief of Staff (m/f/d) unterstützt den CEO dabei, strategische Ziele effizient zu erreichen und die Organisation in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln. Du trägst durch fundierte Analysen und strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen zur Stärkung unserer operativen Exzellenz bei. Deine Aufgaben umfassen die Koordination und Priorisierung von Schlüsselprojekten und das Überwachen und Aussteuern von Initiativen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams. Durch deine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und dein starkes Organisationstalent unterstützt du unser Wachstum und hilfst dabei, Ocumeda erfolgreich auf die nächste Stufe zu bringen. 

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise und Ideen bei vielfältigen Wachstumsprojekten bei uns ein, z.B. dem skalierten Rollout bei Optikern und Wachstum unseres Ärztenetzwerks
  • Du nutzt Deine Erfahrung, um bestehende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln sowie neue, skalierbare Prozesse aufzusetzen
  • Du nutzt Deine Empathie, um Beziehungen mit unseren Partnern auf- und auszubauen
  • Du bringst Deine kreativen Ideen und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten ein, um die Wachstumsherausforderungen eines Startups zu meistern


Das bringst du mit

  • Hohe intrinsische Motivation, etwas zu verändern, und die Suche nach einer sinnhaften Tätigkeit
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement, in der Strategieberatung oder im Venture Growth

  • Freude am Aufbau von Kontakten und Netzwerk sowie Empathie, die das Vertrauen unserer Kund:innen gewinnt

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

title: Product Owner – SDV Data Products (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Adsquare
description_html:
Intro

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

  • Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products.

  • Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements.

  • Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts.

  • Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

  • Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate.

  • Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.


Nice to Have

  • Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically.

  • Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work.


Our Software Stack

  • SQL

  • Jira

  • Confluence

  • API Documentation tools


Why us?

On top of a competitive package…

  • We are open to flexible work models: we work in a hybrid mode.

  • To encourage education and professional growth, we offer an individual yearly budget of €1,200.

  • You are entitled to 30 vacation days per year.

  • Public transport contribution.

  • We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut.

  • We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive.


Salary Range (Annual On-Target Earnings)

65,000 - 70,000


Recruiting Process

  1. HR interview — values-based (30 min)

  2. VP Product interview (45 min)

  3. Case study interview (1 hour)

  4. Team interview (30 min)

  5. Offer


Work model

Hybrid


Desired start date

Asap

title: Working Student (m/f/x) Finance and Accounting
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Circus
description_html:
Our Mission

At Circus (Xetra: CA1), headquartered in Munich, we are pioneering global developments in on-demand autonomous food production. Everything from creation to production and operation – enabled by seamlessly integrated cutting-edge robotics and transformative AI technology.

Our foundation rests in the extensive developments of groundbreaking robotics driven by artificial intelligence, previously the missing link in achieving true autonomous food automation. This is the moment for a new status quo: Just as autonomous driving will disrupt how we build cities, organize our days, and live our lives, so will we shift our whole reality around food.

Our Team is backing a paradigm shift in one of humanity's most important sectors with the sharpest minds in Robotics, AI, Engineering and Culinary, collaborating closely with industry-leading partners to revolutionize every aspect of the food service experience.

Join us as we forge ahead, crafting a future where the art of cooking and the science of technology converge to create a world that thinks differently about food than it has for thousands of years—a world where food means something new.


About the Role

Finance is core to how we run as a publicly listed, fast-scaling company — and you'll be right in the middle of it. As Working Student, you'll own the invoice workflow in Moss end-to-end: from validation to outgoing invoices. You'll work closely with a small, sharp team, see how financial processes actually get built and improved in a scale-up, and have real room to shape how things work, not just keep them running.


Your Daily Business

  • Validate and review incoming invoices in Moss
  • Coordinate and manage the invoice workflow end-to-end
  • Prepare and issue outgoing invoices
  • Maintain invoice data, ensuring completeness and accuracy
  • Liaise with internal departments to resolve invoice-related queries
  • Support the ongoing optimization of the invoicing process


Base Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled student, ideally in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or a related field
  • Confident with MS Office, especially Excel
  • Careful, structured, and independent way of working
  • Good German and English language skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in accounting or invoicing
  • Familiarity with Moss or similar accounting/workflow tools


Our Offer

  • Hands-on insight into the finance operations of a publicly listed company, with potential for longer-term collaboration
  • Flexible working hours compatible with your studies
  • A motivated team and flat hierarchies
  • Discounted Urban Sports Club membership and Wellhub for a variety of well-being offerings

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tablemedia
description_html:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte
  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice
  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur
  • Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt


Deine Bewerbung 

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? 

Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.

description_html:

Zur Verstärkung unseres Finance-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Controller / Senior Controller (m/w/d), der unsere Unternehmenssteuerung mit fundierten Analysen, belastbaren Kennzahlen und klaren Handlungsempfehlungen unterstützt.
