description_html:
ABOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  

At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 70 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.    

 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg, with our HQ in Berlin.  

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Payment Processing team owns the core of Unzer's platform — the systems that authorise, capture and settle every merchant transaction, at high volume and under strict reliability and compliance demands. We're also building AI into both our tooling and our payment flows. The team is cross-functional and owns its services end to end; as Engineering Manager, you'll lead experienced engineers and work closely with Product, Risk and Operations.

 

What your work will look like:

  • Leads, mentors, and grows a team of engineers, owning hiring, performance management, and career development. 

  • Remains hands-on when needed, contributing to the codebase, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting the team with your technical expertise. 

  • Takes accountability for the delivery, quality, and reliability of one or more product areas, balancing technical and business priorities. 

  • Partners with product and other stakeholders to shape roadmaps, plan capacity, and ensure predictable delivery. 

  • Drives continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and processes, and removes blockers for the team. 

  • Contributes to technical and architectural direction, ensuring sound decisions while empowering engineers to own the details. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or similar, with substantial software engineering experience and prior people-management or tech-lead experience. 

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop engineers, and to build inclusive, motivated teams. 

  • Strong technical grounding (e.g., Java, Kotlin, and/or JavaScript, large-scale systems) sufficient to guide architecture and challenge decisions—without needing to be the hands-on expert. 

  • Familiarity with Agentic Software Engineering and AI-driven development lifecycles, and how to adopt them within a team. 

  • Deep understanding of Agile delivery, CI/CD, and quality practices, plus excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across teams and functions.

  • Experience with cloud-based, containerized environments (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

  • Please note that we will not sponsor your visa or relocation, and you must have a valid work permit to be eligible for this position.

title: Senior Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Contabo
description_html:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.

One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.

You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform 
  • Hands-on production experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph) and Kubernetes persistent storage (Longhorn or comparable) 
  • Experience operating API gateways and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress, or comparable), including debugging cross-cutting concerns like CORS and rate limiting 
  • Experience with CDN/edge security, DDoS mitigation, and WAF configuration (e.g. Cloudflare), as well as firewall-rule design 
  • A strong grounding in system design fundamentals (load balancing, caching, sharding/replication, consistency models, message queues) – and the judgment to apply them to real-world trade-offs 
  • Experience designing or maturing observability (tracing, metrics, SLOs/SLIs) with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry is desirable 
  • Experience with secrets/identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), messaging systems (NATS), and building on-call processes and incident runbooks from scratch is a plus 
  • Composure working with grown, incompletely documented systems – paired with the right mix of pragmatism and perfectionism: fix what's broken, retire what's dead, rather than rewriting everything 
  • Genuine enjoyment of acting as the technical go-to person across teams, actively sharing and documenting your knowledge 
  • Professional fluency in English (our working language); German language skills, certifications (CKA/CKS, Ceph training), and experience with virtualization platforms (Proxmox, OpenStack) are a plus

title: Director Marketing (all genders) - GPORTAL (Ociris GmbH)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Contabo
description_html:
Your creative field

At GPORTAL, our vision is to build individual and easy-to-use online gaming experiences for the world. Driven by our “from gamer for gamer” passion, we've grown into one of the leading game server providers - offering more than just servers, unlike other hosting companies. For over 20 years, we've been bringing virtual worlds into people's homes with just a few clicks. Our mission: enabling experts and beginners alike to play their favourite games together with their friends. From Palworld and Enshrouded to Minecraft and Battlefield, we offer around 100 multiplayer games across every genre.


GPORTAL is looking for a Director Marketing who is ready to take the wheel of our entire marketing department, performance marketing, social media, partner management, community management, and graphic design. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will be part of the core management team from day one, with the kind of ownership over people and KPIs you will not find in every gaming company.

In your first six months, the priority is simple: keep the team running strong while you get a real feel for GPORTAL's business, our vision, and where we are headed. You will take full budget responsibility, from managing current spend and staying on top of marketing invoices to building the annual forecast. You will also size up the market to derive strategic conclusions on where we push next.

From there, you settle in as a driving force in our management team and sharpen how the marketing department works so it is well set up for the future. That includes working hand in hand with our tech teams on product-related topics such as checkout flows or game updates and launches. You also take full responsibility for onboarding, managing, and offboarding our external agencies and freelancers. On top of that, you build real connections with the marketing team over at Contabo Group to create synergies wherever possible. Just as important: brand visibility and closeness to the community. GPORTAL is a love brand to its players, and that needs to show up in the social channels and communication tools where our community actually lives.

Alongside that, you own our marketing campaigns with partner studios and the big moments like Black Friday. Last but not least, you advise our CEO directly on D2C pricing based on comprehensive market assessments, both the operative calls today and the strategic thinking further out.

Longer term, you push the KPIs that matter and build retention measures that keep players around. You also shape a team structure that can scale with us. That also means preparing and presenting marketing reporting and KPIs at Group and shareholder level. And you run and assess customer surveys, turning what you learn into decisions we actually act on.

Gaming is a volatile business, and the classic playbook does not always deliver a straight line to growth. We are all pulling for the same outcome for the wider group, which sometimes means short-term compromises we make together. In practice, that also means staying flexible and genuinely meeting people face to face rather than just online.


What convinces us

Ideally, you would have:

  • a strong, hands-on track record leading holistic marketing departments, from performance marketing to social, community, and creative, backed by solid marketing controlling, budget management, and core KPI skills
  • real performance marketing experience, paired with the ability to genuinely inspire a team toward a shared goal
  • some background in IT or hosting, plus experience working with external agencies and freelancers
  • gaming industry exposure is a nice-to-have, though a genuine feel for gaming culture matters just as much as the industry on your CV
  • some exposure to influencer management or social media marketing, and enough confidence to step into a thought-leader role in the market when needed
  • strong communication skills and a knack for handling conflict head-on, with a strategic, analytical mindset that connects campaigns to business outcomes
  • a proactive, hands-on, reliable way of working, comfortable holding yourself to a high bar under pressure
  • an open, global, adaptable mindset with genuine passion for the product and enough flexibility to compromise when the business needs it
  • fluent German and English
 
If this job offer has sparked your interest, please do reach out to us, even if you only meet some of the requirements. We'd love to get to know each other!


Awesome Prospects

  • Make an impact – Take ownership and be part of one of the most exciting growth stories in the industry
  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours and the setup you need to perform at your best
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and a wide range of fitness and wellness options
  • Dive into real challenges – Work on a wide range of technical topics that keep things exciting and far from routine
  • Keep growing – Develop your skills through hands-on experience, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning as a team
  • Learn from the best – Work alongside experienced, open-minded colleagues who support each other and share their knowledge·         
  • Create lasting memories – Join us for workshops and company events where we come together multiple times a year (yes, fully covered)
  • Give back – Take a day off to support social causes through our Volunteer Day
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Have fun along the way – Most people here would say we enjoy what we do… but we’ll let you be the judge


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Katharina by email at katharina.

  • Track Record & Ownership: Du kannst mindestens drei bis vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einer Top-Strategie-/Transformationsberatung, im M&A-Umfeld oder in einer Corporate-Development-Rolle in einem Scale-up vorweisen und hast komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich ins Ziel gesteuert.
  • Hands-on und Pragmatismus: Du verbindest strategische Flughöhe mit operativer Durchsetzungskraft, scheust dich nicht vor Detailarbeit in Daten und Prozessen und löst Engpässe pragmatisch.
  • Senior Projekt-Governance: Du steuerst vielschichtige M&A- und Transformationsprojekte souverän, behältst die Abhängigkeiten im Blick und bleibst auch bei wechselnden Prioritäten stets handlungs- und entscheidungssicher.
  • C-Level- und Stakeholder-Management: Du agierst auf Augenhöhe mit der Geschäftsführung, den Bereichsleiter:innen und den Fachteams. Du kommunizierst präzise, vertrittst Ergebnisse durchsetzungsstark und löst Zielkonflikte eigenständig.
  • Analytische Schärfe und Target Operating Model: Du durchdringst extrem schnell heterogene Daten- und Systemlandschaften, erkennst Synergien und erarbeitest belastbare Zielprozesse und Entscheidungsvorlagen.
  • Advanced AI & Automation: Du setzt GenAI-Tools und Low-Code-Plattformen (z. B. Claude, Make, n8n) routiniert ein, um Prozesse zu automatisieren und Datenströme effizient zu strukturieren.
  • Sprachkompetenz: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch auf C2-Niveau (Wort und Schrift).


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 70.000 € Jahresbrutto*.
  • Einen Job mit Sinn, einer klaren Vision und der seltenen Gelegenheit, mit einem der größten CleanTechs Deutschlands aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Arbeite flexibel aus dem Mobile Office – an bis zu 3 Tagen die Woche.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Sicherheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur bAV und BUV wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20 % unterstützt.
  • Beweg Dich mit Deinem JobRad, klimafreundlich durch die Stadt.
  • Mit FINN JobAuto Leasing kannst du dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem leasen.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben 30 Tagen Urlaub, einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die Corporate Benefits auch eine vergünstigte Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu nilo.health, einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.
 
 Kein Haus gleicht dem anderen, aber für jeden von uns ist es ein Zuhause. Es steht für das, was uns ausmacht, was uns wichtig ist. Hier wollen wir seit jeher geborgen, sicher und ungestört sein.
 
 Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.
 
 Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.
 Für Millionen von Eigenheimen. Gemeinsam. Jeden Tag. Heim für Heim.


Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Überzeugt Dein CV**? Dann gehst Du mit Alex (Talent Acquisition Manager) in einen ersten Austausch.
  • Besteht von beiden Seiten Interesse, steigst Du mit Antonia (Chief of Staff & Head of Corporate Development) tiefer in die Position ein.
  • Passt es weiterhin? Bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, eine Case Study durchzuführen, uns diese vorzustellen und einige Deiner potenziellen Teammitglieder kennenzulernen.
  • Abschließend bist Du in einem finalen Gespräch mit Felix (CEO)
  • Sind alle glücklich? Herzlich willkommen bei thermondo.
* *Vor der Einladung zu einem ersten Gespräch nutzen wir ein KI-gestütztes Tool, das unser Recruiting-Team beim initialen Screening unterstützt und zusätzliche Hinweise zu den Anforderungen der jeweiligen Position liefert. Die Entscheidung über den weiteren Verlauf Deiner Bewerbung treffen immer unsere Recruiter:innen und die zuständigen Hiring Manager:innen.

Los geht's

title: Product Manager Customer Care (f/m/d) | Fixed-Term Parental Leave Cover
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Thermondo
description_html:
We're looking for

Join our innovative team at thermondo as a Product Manger (f/m/d and make a significant impact in reducing carbon footprints in private households. 

We value proactive problem-solving, innovative technology solutions, and the ability to clearly communicate technical information across departments. If you are a passionate to leverage technology for a sustainable future, thermondo is the place for you.


If you enjoy this

  • Developing and executing a strategic product roadmap for Customer Care, ensuring that customers receive fast, high-quality resolutions.
  • Identifying the right opportunities, testing ideas quickly with AI prototypes and turning validated concepts into useful products.
  • Leading a cross-functional team through discovery, prioritisation and delivery.
  • Standardising and automating operational processes with the Customer Care leadership team, ensuring that new solutions work in day-to-day operations.
  • Measuring the impact of your products through customer satisfaction, user feedback and adoption, as well as resolution times and quality, and continuously improving based on what you learn.


And recognise yourself here

  • You have at least three years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally in Customer Care, Service, Support, After-Sales or a related operational environment.
  • Customer Care products: You have built or improved products, workflows or digital experiences that help customers find answers or resolve issues.
  • CRM systems: You have hands-on experience with CRM systems. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud is particularly relevant.
  • AI applications: You have a strong curiosity about AI and initial practical experience with AI copilots, agents or comparable solutions in a product or operational context.
  •  Automation: You have standardised or automated processes to improve efficiency, quality or consistency.
  • Data-driven product work: You use metrics, customer feedback and qualitative insights to prioritise opportunities and measure product impact.
  • Stakeholder management: You can align business partners with different perspectives around a clear roadmap and make sound prioritisation decisions.
  • Very good German skills at C1 level and English skills at C2 level are required.


What we have to offer

  • In this role, you can expect an attractive compensation package starting from €62.000
  • Join a team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Designers, Data and Salesforce people who are excellent in their craft and are happy to share their knowledge and help you grow alongside them
  • Our team is using the latest frameworks and is working with a modern tech stack to build powerful products for our customers, craftspeople, and internal teams
  • Boost your skills with a dedicated annual learning budget to spend on conferences, courses or books 
  • Choose your own AI coding companion – we provide you with the license for the AI model or assistant of your choice 
  • We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world becomes for future generations
  • We offer a fantastic culture in the tech team and beyond
    • Modern office in the heart of Berlin
    • Work from home - up to 3 days a week
    • You receive an Urban Sports Club membership & nilo.health membership
    • You can lease a job bike or bring your dog one day/week
    • Corporate Benefits at more than 100 partners
    • 20% employer contribution to your pension and disability insurance


About us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. Today, our proprietary software enables 800 thermondinos to scale the heating transition in Germany. But we want more. We want to enable fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management. 
Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments. 
 
Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate neutral living.


Your application process

  • An initial interview with your Talent Acquisition partner Alex
  • After this stage, you will talk with our Head of Customer Product Sarah
  • Next you'll receive a Case Study 
  • Then, you will have the opportunity to meet with your to-be teammates in the office 
  • Finally, Become a thermondino!
* Before inviting you to an initial interview, we use an AI-supported tool that helps our recruiting team with the initial screening and provides additional insights into the requirements of the respective position. The decision on how to proceed with your application is always made by our recruiters and the responsible hiring managers.
* The specific salary level is determined during the recruitment process and depends on your experience, qualifications, and the scope of responsibility associated with the position.


Here we go

Is this exactly the challenge you are looking for? Then don't wait any longer and apply to us. We look forward to getting to know you!

title: Trainee -  Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Reisetopia
description_html:
Intro

Du willst nach dem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung praktisch durchstarten, hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du von Anfang an mit anpackst und wirklich etwas lernst? Dann steig als Trainee Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d) bei uns ein und unterstütze unser Team in Berlin an der Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltung, Office Management und CEO Support!Wir empfangen dich in einem Team, das sich gerne neuen Herausforderungen stellt, dich Schritt für Schritt einarbeitet und dir echte Verantwortung überträgt, sobald du dich sicher fühlst.Wir besetzen diese Position zunächst befristet für ein Jahr, da eine Kollegin aus unserem Team für einige Monate eine berufliche Auszeit nimmt. Im Anschluss schauen wir gemeinsam, wie eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit aussehen kann.Idealerweise startest du zum 1. oder 15. Oktober, damit genug Zeit für eine gute Einarbeitung und Übergabe bleibt.


Deine Aufgaben bei reisetopia

reisetopia ist in den vergangenen Jahren deutlich gewachsen. Als Trainee lernst du dabei nach und nach, worauf es in dieser vielseitigen Position ankommt – ein gutes Auge für Zahlen, Struktur und Prozesse. Du wirst von unserem Team eng begleitet und wächst Schritt für Schritt in folgende Bereiche hinein:

Buchhaltung & Finanzadministration

  • Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Erfassung, Prüfung und Zuordnung von Belegen in Datev
  • Tägliches Monitoring unserer Bankkonten und Zahlungseingänge sowie Pflege unserer Liquiditätsplanung
  • Erstellung von Rechnungen für Partner sowie Provisionsabrechnungen
  • Übertragung und Aufbereitung der BWA in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO
  • Bearbeitung von Reisekostenabrechnungen und Einsammeln von Belegen aus dem Team
Office Management & Unternehmensadministration
  • Organisation von Events und internen Team-Anlässen
  • Verantwortung für Bestellungen (z. B. Büro-/Lebensmittelbestellungen) und allgemeine Maintenance-Themen im Office
  • Pflege interner Unternehmensseiten (u. a. „Über uns", Onboarding- und Mitarbeiterseiten) sowie unserer internen Notion-Wissensdatenbank
  • Sicherstellung regelmäßiger Backups unternehmensrelevanter Daten
  • Weiterentwicklung interner Prozesse und Dokumentationen, damit sich Kolleg:innen im Alltag eigenständig zurechtfinden
CEO Support
  • Ausgefeiltes Kalendermanagement für unseren Geschäftsführer Moritz
  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für interne Formate wie unser vierteljährliches Company Update oder Management-Meetings
  • Unterstützung bei allgemeinen Projekten zur Unternehmensentwicklung

Zusätzlich lernst du im Laufe deines Traineeships auch projektbezogene Themen kennen, die für Abwechslung sorgen und dir einen breiten Einblick in die Unternehmensentwicklung geben. Wichtig ist uns vor allem deine Lernbereitschaft – Erfahrung sammelst du bei uns.


Das erwarten wir von Dir

Das zeichnet Dich für diese Position besonders aus:

  • Große Lust, dich schnell und selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und stetig dazuzulernen
  • Ein gutes Auge für Zahlen und Daten sowie Freude an Organisation
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im (Projekt-)Management oder die Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu strukturieren, zu priorisieren und voranzutreiben
  • Hohe Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit, um Dich in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Umfeld schnell zurechtzufinden
  • Interesse an Buchhaltungs- und Finanzthemen; erste Berührungspunkte (z.B. aus Studium, Ausbildung oder Praktika) sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel; Vorkenntnisse in Datev, Teams und Notion sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und diskrete Arbeitsweise – insbesondere im Umgang mit vertraulichen Finanz- und Unternehmensdaten
  • Hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wünschenswert: Abgeschlossenes Studium oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Bürokauffrau/-mann, Steuerfachangestellte/r) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Ein zusätzliches Plus: erste Erfahrung in einer Assistenz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Office-Management-Rolle sowie Interesse an Finanzen und (Luxus-)Reisen

Grundlegend für alle Stellen gilt bei uns ein Fokus auf Teamarbeit, Spaß an der Sache und Proaktivität. Wir schätzen neue Ideen und fordern Dich bei Deiner Arbeit täglich heraus.


Das erwartet Dich bei reisetopia

Inmitten der Hauptstadtmetropole bieten wir Dir ein junges und agiles Arbeitsumfeld. Als Kernelemente der DNA von reisetopia gestalten flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für Home oder Travel Office den Arbeitsalltag besonders dynamisch.

Für diese Position liegt das Jahresgehalt zwischen 30.000,00 Euro und 35.000,00 Euro brutto, abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Die Stelle ist dem Junior-Level zugeordnet.

Wir bieten eine Menge für deinen Einsatz - von einmaligen Teamtrips und außergewöhnlichen Teamevents bis hin zu einmaligen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem rasant wachsendem Unternehmen. Wir empfangen Dich in einer familiären Atmosphäre und bieten eine ganze Reihe an Add-ons, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag verschönern:

  • Beste Arbeitsbedingungen in unserem Büro in der Nähe vom am Potsdamer Platz
  • Deutschlandticket Job oder Job Rad
  • Mittagsessenzuschuss und monatliches Catering
  • Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in Höhe von 500 Euro im Jahr
  • Kostenfreier Barista-Kaffee sowie verschiedene Kaltgetränke
  • Snacks und frisches Obst
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Möglichkeiten eigene Projekte umzusetzen
  • Cashback für Buchung über suitespot
  • Moderne und einfache Zeiterfassung mit voller Flexibilität
  • Aktive Unterstützung durch kostenlose und anonyme Coachings zur Verbesserung der mentalen Gesundheit
  • Zuschuss zu Deiner Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft
  • Exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte für Shopping, Reisen und vieles mehr
Damit Du unser Produkt auch persönlich kennenlernst, gibt es für Dich zusätzlich zum Start ein kostenloses Wochenende mit reisetopia Hotels Vorteilen im Waldorf Astoria Berlin!

Bereit Deine Reise zu beginnen? Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, in der Du uns zeigst, warum gerade Du perfekt in unser ambitioniertes Team passt!

title: (Senior) ERP Consultant DMS (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Asseco Solutions
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Consultant DMS berätst du unsere mittelständischen Kunden rund um Dokumentenmanagement und digitale Dokumentenprozesse im Umfeld unseres ERP-Systems APplus.
Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende DMS-Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Projektmanagerinnen, Entwicklerinnen sowie den Key-Usern unserer Kunden zusammen.

  • Aufnahme und Bewertung von Kundenanforderungen sowie Erstellung von Spezifikationen
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Kunden bei der Prozessoptimierung und Effizienzsteigerung
  • Analyse, Konzeption und Implementierung von Geschäftsprozessen in APplus
  • Konfiguration und Customizing des ERP-Systems in einem oder mehreren Fachbereichen
  • Durchführung von Tests, Fehleranalysen und Qualitätssicherung der ERP-Prozesse
  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen für Key-User und Endanwender
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Dokumentationen, Schulungsunterlagen und Prozessbeschreibungen
  • Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung standardisierter, wiederverwendbarer ERP-Prozesslösungen

Je nach Erfahrungslevel zusätzlich:

  • Koordination von Arbeitspaketen und Mentoring von Kollegen
  • Fachliche Führung im Consulting-Team, Entwicklung von Best Practices und Begleitung strategischer ERP-Entscheidungen


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes kaufmännisches oder technisches Studium bzw. vergleichbare Qualifikationen
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als ERP-Consultant oder ERP-Key-User
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis betriebswirtschaftlicher Prozesse
  • Erfahrung in der Implementierung und im Customizing von ERP-Systemen
  • Berufserfahrung im DMS-Consulting, Dokumentenmanagement oder in der Digitalisierung von Dokumentenprozessen
  • Erfahrung mit einem DMS-, ECM- oder Archivierungssystem
  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Arbeit mit Kund*innen
  • Sicheres Auftreten, Präsentationskompetenz und Teamgeist
  • Bereitschaft zu moderater Reisetätigkeit

Je nach Erfahrungslevel zusätzlich:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer ERP-Projekte
  • Fähigkeit, Prozesse strategisch zu gestalten und abteilungsübergreifende Lösungen zu entwickeln
  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung und im Mentoring von Kolleg*innen


Unser Angebot

  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld
  • Verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselrolle in anspruchsvollen ERP-Projekten
  • Vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld in dem Du Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein Potenzial langfristig einbringen kannst
  • Intensive Einarbeitung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildung in unserem hauseigenen Trainingscenter sowie die Betreuung durch eine*n Mentor*in 
  • Flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamarbeit und Spaß an der Arbeit großgeschrieben werden
  • Flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit Mobile Office Möglichkeit und einem attraktiven Gehaltspaket
  • Den Arbeitsalltag bereichern wir mit Kaffee, Getränken, Benefits wie Betriebsfeiern und Teamevents, Fahrradleasing sowie Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte

title: Werkstudent PR & Marketing (m/w/d)

description_html:
Was dich erwartet

Der erste Eindruck von uns entsteht auf einer Messe, in einem LinkedIn-Beitrag oder in einer Bewertung. Bisher kümmert sich niemand gezielt darum – ab jetzt du. Als Werkstudent PR & Marketing (m/w/d) verantwortest du unseren Außenauftritt eigenständig, in direkter Abstimmung mit unserem CSO. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Messeauftritte – von der Vorbereitung über die Umsetzung vor Ort bis zur Nachbereitung.
  • Einmal pro Woche geht ein fachlicher LinkedIn-Beitrag raus. Du entwickelst ihn von der Idee über den Text bis zum fertigen Post.
  • Unser Bild in Bewertungsportalen liegt in deiner Hand – Google und Trustpilot im Blick, Themen daraus ableiten.
  • Du bringst unsere Marke auch nach innen: von kleinen Employer Branding Projekten bis zu den sichtbaren Details im Büro.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Ideen, wo wir sonst noch sichtbar werden sollten, und bringst sie zur Umsetzung.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, PR oder etwas Vergleichbares.
  • Du hast in diesem Bereich bereits praktisch gearbeitet – Praktikum, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine vergleichbare Station. Diese Stelle ist kein Einstieg zum Reinschnuppern.
  • Du schreibst sicher auf Deutsch und triffst dabei unterschiedliche Tonalitäten; Englisch ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast ein Auge für Gestaltung und merkst, wenn etwas nicht sauber aussieht.
  • Du kannst 16–20 Stunden pro Woche einbringen und bist regelmäßig bei uns im Büro.


Was wir versprechen

Arbeitsumgebung & Flexibilität

  • Office-First Company
  • Modernes, klimatisiertes Büro mit viel Tageslicht
  • Zentrale Lage zwischen Gleisdreieck und Potsdamer Platz mit sehr guter Anbindung
  • Große Dachterrasse mit Blick über Berlin
  • Arbeitszeiten nach deinem Stundenplan, in Klausurenphasen reduzieren wir gemeinsam

Benefits

  • Freie Getränke, frisches Obst und Müsli
  • 100 % Übernahme deines Deutschlandtickets
  • Dein Hund ist ein Teamplayer? Perfekt – tierische Unterstützung ist bei uns willkommen.
  • Corporate Benefits Account mit Rabatten für viele Marken
  • Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberanteil
  • Nintendo Switch, PS5, Dart und Tischkicker für nach Feierabend

Kultur & Zusammenarbeit

  • Agiles Mindset und offene Kommunikation – jede Stimme zählt
  • Praxistaugliches juristisches Wissen, das du sonst nirgends nebenbei mitnimmst
  • Du gestaltest unsere Reise aktiv mit
  • Feedback ist bei uns keine Floskel, sondern ein echter Gamechanger
Dein Weg zu uns: 
  1. Du schickst uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir melden uns schnellstmöglich zurück.
  2. Telefonat mit dem HR-Team, ca. 20 Minuten.
  3. Kennenlernen deiner Vorgesetzten - ca. 30 Minuten per Video.
  4. Kennenlernen vor Ort - ca. 60 Minuten.
  5. Danach erhältst du dein Angebot.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin: Nadine ·

title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Legalhero
description_html:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process
  • Your application as an AI Product Engineer (Senior) - short and to the point
  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team
  • Approx. 60-minute in-person interview with your hiring manager
  • Approx. 30-minute discussion with the management team
  • A prompt job offer
Your contact: Nadine · HR Manager ·

title: Team Lead Sales Development (AI x Renewables)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Dein Impact

We’re building the AI platform for energy installers and want to change how the industry works. Founded in 2023, graduated from Y Combinator in 2024, and now a team of 70 in our Berlin office near Weinbergspark. And we have much more ahead.
As Team Lead Sales Development, you’ll continuously develop our SDR team, processes, and sales playbook. You’ll coach, set ambitious targets, and pick up the phone yourself. In doing so, you’ll build a strong outbound pipeline and drive our growth.

Location: Berlin, on-site
Employment type: Full-time

  • Lead and develop our SDR team. Help each rep improve through regular 1:1s, call reviews, practical coaching, and clear development goals.
  • Own pipeline generation. Translate monthly and quarterly targets into actionable plans, tracking both performance and opportunity quality.
  • Lead by example. Make cold calls, test new approaches, and show your team how to run effective conversations with decision-makers.
  • Build a strong outbound culture. Make preparation, consistent prospecting, structured follow-ups, and shared learning part of the team’s daily routine.
  • Develop our sales playbook. Refine messaging, call scripts, and outreach sequences for heating and solar installation businesses.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership. Align on target customers, qualification criteria, and smooth handoffs.
  • Improve our processes. Use CRM data, automation, and AI tools to reduce repetitive tasks and give your team more time with prospects.


Requirements

  • At least one year of outbound sales experience, with a track record of generating qualified opportunities through cold calling.
  • One to two years of sales leadership experience, including coaching and managing team performance.
  • An understanding of SMB sales and the ability to connect with business owners and decision-makers.
  • A structured approach to targets and metrics, with the judgment to identify where your team needs support.
  • Initiative, resilience, and the ability to turn ideas into action quickly.
  • Excellent English communication skills, plus C2 proficiency in German, Italian, or French.
  • Enthusiasm for AI, software, and the energy transition. Experience in SaaS sales or the installation industry is a plus.
  • Confidence using CRM systems. Experience with HubSpot and sales automation is an advantage.


Was wir bieten

  • Room to shape how we grow: Develop our outbound strategy, strengthen the SDR team, and put your ideas into practice.
  • Professional growth: Build your leadership skills in an ambitious climate tech company with fast decisions.
  • Real ownership: Take responsibility for your team and its contribution to autarc’s growth.
  • Office in Berlin-Mitte: Work with us in our beautiful office near Weinbergspark.
  • Modern equipment: A MacBook and 27-inch monitor, with the freedom to choose your own equipment.
  • Annual team retreat: Spend time with the entire team at our yearly retreat.
  • Mobility package: Choose between JobRad and Dance Bike.
  • Fitness package: Choose between Urban Sports and ClassPass.
  • Open team culture: Work with supportive colleagues who value direct feedback and collaboration.
  • Visible impact: Help installation businesses work more efficiently and deliver more energy projects.


Next steps

  1. Apply online with your CV. Your contact is Philipp Hulm (Sales Lead).
  2. After reviewing your application, we’ll get back to you about the next steps.
  3. We’ll start with a 30-minute Google Meet interview with someone from our Sales team.
  4. Next, you’ll have a 30-minute Google Meet interview with our founder, Thies.
  5. We’ll then invite you to meet us in person at our Berlin office.
Don’t meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We’d love to get to know you.

title: Senior Sales Development Representative
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Dein Impact

Du baust die Outbound Engine, die autarc in die nächste Wachstumsphase bringt. Als Senior Sales Development Lead verantwortest du unsere Outbound-Pipeline. Du verbindest Strategie mit täglicher Umsetzung: die richtigen Zielgruppen identifizieren, starke Ansprache entwickeln, Menschen besser machen und aus guten Gesprächen verlässlich neue Sales-Chancen schaffen. Dabei gehst du selbst ans Telefon, testest neue Ansätze und setzt den Standard für dein Team. Dich erwarten hohes Tempo, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Verantwortung für unser Wachstum.

Standort: Berlin

  • Outbound-Pipeline verantworten: Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Outbound-Pipeline – von der Auswahl passender Accounts über die Erstansprache bis zur qualifizierten Übergabe an unser Sales Team.
  • Selbst vorangehen: Du bist als Player-Coach aktiv in der Akquise. Du führst selbst Cold Calls, testest Gesprächseinstiege und Einwandbehandlung und zeigst deinem Team, wie aus einem ersten Kontakt eine echte Sales-Chance wird.
  • Outbound-Strategie entwickeln: Du legst fest, welche Zielgruppen wir mit welchen Botschaften über welche Kanäle erreichen. Cold Calling ist der Kern, ergänzt durch weitere Kontaktpunkte wie LinkedIn, E-Mail und Messen.
  • Neue ICPs und Personas erschließen: Gemeinsam mit unserem GTM-Team entwickelst und validierst du neue ideale Kundenprofile und Buyer Personas. Du priorisierst Segmente und findest heraus, wo wir wiederholbar qualifizierte Pipeline aufbauen können.
  • Prozesse und Playbooks aufbauen: Du entwickelst klare Standards für Recherche, Ansprache, Follow-ups, Qualifizierung und Übergabe. Erfolgreiche Ansätze übersetzt du in Playbooks, die das gesamte Team im Alltag nutzen kann.
  • Performance steuern: Du definierst gemeinsam mit Sales klare Ziele und steuerst das Team anhand relevanter Kennzahlen – von erreichten Entscheidern und qualifizierten Terminen bis zu akzeptierten Sales-Chancen und generierter Pipeline. Du erkennst Engpässe und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
  • Tools und Daten nutzbar machen: Du sorgst für saubere CRM-Daten, transparente Reports und einen sinnvollen Einsatz unserer Sales-Tools. Dein Team soll seine Zeit in gute Gespräche investieren können.
  • Hiring und Onboarding mitgestalten: Du hilfst uns, weitere Talente zu gewinnen, und entwickelst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, mit dem neue Teammitglieder schnell produktiv werden.
  • Eng mit GTM, Sales und Produkt arbeiten: Du stellst sicher, dass aus dem Feedback deiner Gespräche bessere Botschaften, eine präzisere Positionierung und wertvolle Impulse für unsere Software entstehen.


Requirements

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Outbound-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Technologieunternehmen, und hast nachweislich qualifizierte Pipeline aufgebaut.
  • Du hast bereits ein SDR-, BDR- oder Outbound-Team geführt oder als Senior im Team konkrete Verantwortung für Coaching, Onboarding und gemeinsame Ergebnisse übernommen.
  • Du beherrschst Cold Calling aus eigener Praxis. Du kannst gute Gespräche selbst führen und anderen verständlich vermitteln, was sie erfolgreich macht.
  • Du weißt, wie man aus einzelnen erfolgreichen Vertriebsaktivitäten einen verlässlichen Prozess entwickelt – mit klaren Zielgruppen, relevanter Ansprache und konsequenten Follow-ups.
  • Du kannst Leistung einfordern und Menschen dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen. Du gibst direktes, konstruktives Feedback und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem dein Team Verantwortung übernimmt.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und datenbasiert. Du erkennst, ob ein Engpass bei der Aktivität, Erreichbarkeit, Gesprächsqualität oder Qualifizierung liegt, und setzt dort an.
  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnell wachsenden Startup wohl, triffst Entscheidungen und bringst neue Ideen zügig in die Umsetzung.
  • Du gehst sicher mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM um und hast Erfahrung mit gängigen Outbound- und Lead-Generation-Tools.
  • Du begeisterst dich für die Transformation der Energiebranche und möchtest mit deinem Team innovative Software im Handwerk etablieren.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch.


Was wir bieten

  • Growth-Mindset: Werde Teil eines ehrgeizigen und motivierten Teams in einem schnell wachsenden Climate Tech-Startup – finanziert von führenden Venture Capitalists und Business Angels.
  • Echte Verantwortung: Übernimm eigenständig die Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Startups.
  • Dynamische Organisationsstruktur: Bringe deine Lebenssituation optimal mit deiner Arbeit in Einklang, mit Schwerpunkt auf flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Lösungen und Work-Life-Balance.
  • Büro in Berlin-Mitte: Unser Büro liegt in der Nähe des Weinbergsparks in Berlin-Mitte.
  • Modernes Equipment: MacBook und 27” Bildschirm. Du hast die Freiheit, dein eigenes Equipment auszuwählen.
  • Jährliches Team-Retreat: Teilnahme an einem jährlichen Retreat mit dem gesamten Team.
  • Mobilitätspaket: Wähle zwischen einem JobRad und Dance Bike für deine Mobilität.
  • Fitnesspaket: Entscheide dich zwischen Urban Sports und Classpass für deine Fitness.
  • Kollegiales und familiäres Team: Ein kollegiales und familiäres Team heißt dich willkommen, geprägt von einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.
  • Teil der Energiewende: Sei ein Teil der Energiewende und erlebe den Impact deiner täglichen Arbeit direkt.


Next steps

  • Bewirb dich online mit einem aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf.
  • Dein Ansprechpartner ist Philipp Hulm (Sales Lead).
  • Nach dem Screening erhältst Du von uns Bescheid, ob wir gemeinsam mit Dir den nächsten Schritt gehen möchten.
  • Im ersten Schritt führen wir mit Dir ein ca. 30-minütiges Google-Meet-Interview mit einer Person aus unserem Sales Team.
  • Im zweiten Schritt führen wir mit Dir ein weiteres ca. 30-minütiges Google-Meet-Interview mit unserem Gründer Thies.
  • Danach laden wir Dich zu einem Face-2-Face Interview in unser Berliner Büro ein.

description_html:
Company

As a Business Development Intern, you are responsible for making autarc visible in the UK market, winning over new customers, and laying the foundation for long-term partnerships.

Start: January 2027
Location: Berlin

  • You cultivate and develop relationships with B2B customers such as heating contractors and solar installers by proactively reaching out, sparking interest, and generating appointments for product demos.
  • You leverage multiple channels for new customer acquisition, with a clear focus on outbound calls, trade show activities, and a presence on platforms like LinkedIn.
  • You guide prospects through clear and compelling software demos, identify their needs, and show how autarc can simplify their day-to-day work.
  • You identify new market opportunities, projects, and partnerships, contributing directly to autarc's growth.
  • You actively monitor industries and competitors to better understand market needs and further strengthen our offering.
  • You work closely with our product and expansion team to feed customer feedback directly into the ongoing development of the software.


Requirements

  • You have a passion for software sales and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • You bring a proactive, flexible, and solution-oriented way of working and hold yourself to high standards for your own results.
  • You are a strong communicator, able to win people over and confidently guide stakeholders through conversations.
  • You are passionate about transforming the energy industry and enjoy championing innovative solutions.
  • You speak fluent English
  • Initial experience with HubSpot or other lead generation tools is a plus.


What we offer

Growth mindset: Become part of an ambitious and driven team at a fast-growing climate tech startup – backed by leading venture capitalists and business angels.
Real ownership: Take independent ownership of your work packages within a fast-growing startup.
Dynamic organizational structure: Align your personal life with your work, with an emphasis on flexible hours, remote options, and work-life balance.
Modern equipment: MacBook and 27" monitor. You're free to choose your own equipment.
Annual team retreat: Join an annual retreat with the entire team.
Mobility package: Choose between a JobRad and a Dance bike for your mobility.
Fitness package: Pick between Urban Sports Club and ClassPass for your fitness.
Collegial, family-like team: A collegial and close-knit team welcomes you, shaped by an open company culture.
Part of the energy transition: Be part of the energy transition and experience the impact of your daily work firsthand.


Next steps

  • Apply online with a compelling CV.

  • After that, we'll invite you to a face-to-face interview at our Berlin office.

title: Internship Go-to-Market Engineering, AI & Automation (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

Company

Founded in Berlin, autarc is a 65 person start-up which graduated from Y Combinator in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations and we serve more then 2.000 customers in Germany. 

Our next step is to expand into new countries and the UK market is next – that is why we are looking for a motivated and ambitious Intern to join our team in Berlin.

  • Hands on support of our sales team in their day-to-day work, including customer contact

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics or software engineering
  • Previous startup, consulting or VC experience
  • Fluent in English

title: Junior Data & Analytics Consultant (M/F/D)

description_html:
YOUR ROLE

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE APPLYING BOTH ANALYTICAL AND STRATEGIC AI‑DRIVEN APPROACHES. THROUGH TARGETED STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT AND EARLY IDENTIFICATION OF AI OPPORTUNITIES, YOU PROVIDE KEY IMPULSES FOR KXL’S AI AND DATA STRATEGY.
As a Junior Data & Analytics Consultant (m/f/d) at UX Intelligence, you will work with cross‑disciplinary teams of researchers, designers, developers, data experts, and business stakeholders in a hybrid work environment. You will take responsibility for identifying, shaping, and delivering AI use cases – including use‑case scoping, strategic consulting for UX teams, and the facilitation of workshops that support the adoption of AI‑enabled ways of working. In this role, it is essential that you bring experience in AI applications and AI strategy and are able to communicate complex AI concepts clearly, strategically, and empathetically to diverse audiences.


YOUR PROFILE

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Extract meaningful insights from complex datasets using advanced AI, analytics techniques, and data visualization. 
  • Translate insights into strategic recommendations to foster data-driven decision-making.
  • Create dashboards and reports based on Allianz toolstack (Power BI, Tableau) and consult on data visualization best practices.
  • Identify and consult on data & AI use cases to bring the project/team/tribe to an appropriate maturity level.
  • Consult Allianz project/tribe/team and KXL regarding data and AI use cases as well as AI governance within Allianz. 
  • Build machine learning models, AI agents, and multi-agent systems for Allianz and KXL use cases (in cooperation with data scientists).
  • Review and assess analytics setup, support with implementing and optimizing analytics solutions, and derive insights from analytics data.
  • Support and deliver training sessions, demos, and hands-on workshops to build data & AI literacy; create guidelines, templates, and playbooks for responsible AI adoption.
  • Apply and advocate for AI Usage & Quality Guidelines, ensuring compliance with privacy, fairness, and regulatory standards.
  • Monitor emerging AI trends (tools, methods, regulations) and translate them into actionable recommendations; prepare stakeholder updates and summaries.

title: Chief of Staff (Strategy & Operations)(All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at PREMATCH Sports GmbH
description_html:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


tl;dr

We're looking for a Chief of Staff who works closely with Nik to structurally build out our company- & org processes. 


Main information

  • Start: immediately (flexible start)
  • Location: Cologne
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Founder's Office


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week.
  • Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role.
  • Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently.
  • Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community.
  • Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap.


What you'll do - your playing field

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • End-to-end ownership of selected strategic and operational projects from concept to execution
  • Building and continuously improving central company processes
  • Close collaboration with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and prioritization
  • Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed
  • Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team


What you bring to the team

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Strong process- and structure-oriented thinking, even in ambiguity
  • Experience independently executing projects in a fast-growing environment
  • Tools: Notion, project management tool, Google Workspace, Slack
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you.


Bonus

Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup
  • Early experience building People/org processes


The Prematch Setup

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now.

  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Now it's your turn.

  • Click on ‘Apply now’ – it’ll only take 2 minutes.
  • All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
  • Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit – just apply

title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at LiveEO GmbH
description_html:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Government Solutions (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at LiveEO GmbH
description_html:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

At LiveEO, we combine Space Technology with AI to solve problems here on Earth. Our satellite-based monitoring solutions help Infrastructure operators and industrial companies to make their operations more ecological, safer, and more efficient.

LiveEO is applying the latest developments in artificial intelligence to analyse satellite data and is bringing the insights of earth observation data to customers in the enterprise sector. LiveEO’s ambitious goal is to monitor 1 billion assets across the globe with its unique SaaS solution until 2030. Our team is as global as the satellite data we process and the customers we serve. Together, we are building something big.

Our Government team is growing fast: dedicated business development for Germany and for EU institutions, with more to come. What it doesn't have yet is marketing — the force multiplier. As our first dedicated Government marketing hire, you will build LiveEO's defence & government marketing from the ground up: positioning, content, PR and events, as a true generalist who owns the whole picture.


Your challenge

1. Positioning & product marketing

  • Own government/defence positioning, messaging and value propositions — resilience, situational awareness, ISR — across LiveEO's offering including our own satellite constellation, Twinspector
  • Build and maintain the collateral suite: capability briefs, decks, one-pagers, materials supporting tenders and more
  • Own the government presence on the LiveEO website and keep messaging sharp against competitor/peer positioning in the European defence-tech and EO landscape
2. Strategic communications, Content, PR & visibility
  • Build and execute the strategic communications and  content plan: white papers, expert articles, use-case stories
  • Own press releases and announcements (contracts, partnerships, milestones) together with leadership
  • Build relationships with defence, security and space trade media across Germany and Europe
  • Drive executive visibility: LinkedIn presence, interviews, speaking opportunities for the Government leadership
3. Events
  • Own the defence & government event calendar across Europe (e.g. AFCEA, Berlin Security Conference, ILA, Eurosatory, space/EO industry events and NATO-affiliated formats)
  • Run participation end-to-end: selection and budget, booth/presence, speaking slots, briefing the BD team, structured lead follow-up
4. Build the function
  • Create the Government marketing playbook from scratch — processes, templates, agency/freelancer network where needed
  • Keep a simple view of what works (share of voice, inbound interest, event outcomes) and feed it back into planning with BD and central marketing


Your profile

  • 6–7+ years of marketing, sales or similar experience in the defense or secutiry sector. You are familiar with defence-tech, military lingo and communication towards armed forces.
  • Generalist track record covering product marketing, content, PR and events — not just one discipline
  • Excellent writing and editing in German (C1+) and English — from press release to capability brief
  • Understanding of how government/defense organizations communicate and procure (protocol, sensitivity, long cycles)
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Berlin (hybrid); willingness to travel ~20–30% across Europe
  • Eligibility for security clearance (typically requiring EU or NATO citizenship)
  • Familiarity with Earth observation, space or geospatial technology is a plus
  • Additional European languages (French especially useful for EU/NATO scope) is a plus
  • Public affairs / government relations exposure is a plus


Your Benefits

  • Gain direct insights into and influence strategic business decisions shaping our go-to-market (GTM) strategy, while working on cutting-edge SaaS and AI solutions that enhance business processes and lives globally.
  • Join a rapidly growing multinational leader in an evolving and impactful industry, surrounded by a talented, international team of experts from 30+ nationalities.
  • Flexible working hours - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance
  • Enjoy significant responsibility with the autonomy to drive change, shape processes, and innovate. We encourage career development, creativity, and bold ideas.
  • Benefit from a culture of continuous learning, with frequent internal workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, journal clubs, and hackathons.
  • Receive fair remuneration with the opportunity to participate in company ownership through our VESOP (Virtual Employee Stock Option Plan).
  • Wellness, life insurance and other benefits
  • At LiveEO, we value diverse backgrounds and experiences. We encourage anyone with a strong profile to apply, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, or religion.
